parts.title: Part 1: Multiple Choice — Inversion, Subjunctive, Idioms & Confusable Lexis (Câu 1–15)
parts.instructions: Choose the best option (A, B, C, or D) to complete each of the following sentences.

questions.stem: 1. _______ as it may seem to laypeople, quantum entanglement allows particles to correlate instantaneously across vast cosmic distances.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: A — "Counterintuitive"] Cấu trúc nhượng bộ C1/C2: "Adj + as/though + S + linking verb (seem/be/appear)" = Although it may seem counterintuitive. Không dùng "However" khi đã có "as".
explanation.en: Fronted adjective + as/though expresses concession.

vocabItem.meaningVi: ngược với trực giác thông thường
vocabItem.example: Counterintuitive as it may seem, higher road capacity can increase congestion.

questions.stem: 2. So entrenched _______ within the municipal bureaucracy that three successive reform commissions failed to uproot it.

explanation.rule: Inversion with "So + Adj + be + S + that..."
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: D — "was institutional patronage"] Khi "So + tính từ" được đảo lên đầu câu để nhấn mạnh mức độ, động từ "be" phải đảo lên trước chủ ngữ ("was institutional patronage").
explanation.en: Fronted "So + adjective" triggers subject-verb inversion.

vocabItem.meaningVi: chủ nghĩa thân hữu / nâng đỡ trong bộ máy
vocabItem.example: The reform aimed to dismantle institutional patronage.

questions.stem: 3. It is imperative that every autonomous vehicle _______ rigorous adversarial stress-testing before public deployment.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: B — "undergo"] Sau cấu trúc giả định "It is imperative that + S + V_bare", dùng động từ nguyên mẫu không "es" ("undergo").
explanation.en: Adjectives of urgency trigger the bare infinitive subjunctive.

vocabItem.meaningVi: trải qua kiểm thử chịu tải khắc nghiệt
vocabItem.example: Banks must undergo rigorous stress-testing.

questions.stem: 4. Little _______ that their seemingly innocuous metadata was being aggregated into psychometric voter profiles.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: C — "did the platform users suspect"] "Little" mang nghĩa phủ định đứng đầu câu cùng các động từ nhận thức (know, realize, suspect, imagine) bắt buộc đảo trợ động từ ("did the platform users suspect").
explanation.en: Fronted restrictive "Little" requires auxiliary inversion.

vocabItem.meaningVi: bề ngoài có vẻ vô hại
vocabItem.example: Seemingly innocuous comments can conceal deep bias.

questions.stem: 5. Only by decoupling industrial productivity from fossil-fuel extraction _______ hope to avert irreversible biosphere tipping points.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: C — "can humanity"] Khi "Only by + V-ing" đứng đầu câu, mệnh đề chính phải đảo trợ động từ/modal verb lên trước chủ ngữ ("can humanity hope").
explanation.en: "Only by..." at the start of a sentence triggers inversion in the matrix clause.

vocabItem.meaningVi: các ngưỡng tới hạn của sinh quyển
vocabItem.example: Scientists warn of irreversible biosphere tipping points.

questions.stem: 6. _______ the archival manuscripts not been hermetically sealed in nitrogen vaults, theink would have oxidized centuries ago.

explanation.rule: Inverted Third Conditional ("Had + S + not + Vp2")
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: D — "Had"] Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 3 ở thể phủ định: "Had + S + not + been + Vp2" (chữ "not" luôn đứng sau chủ ngữ, không viết Hadn’t).
explanation.en: Inverted third conditional places "Had" before the subject and "not" after the subject.

vocabItem.meaningVi: được niêm phong kín tuyệt đối
vocabItem.example: The artifacts were kept in hermetically sealed chambers.

questions.stem: 7. Such _______ of the witnesses’ testimonies that the presiding judge declared an immediate mistrial.

explanation.rule: Inversion with "Such + be + Noun Phrase + that..."
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: A — "was the inconsistency"] Cấu trúc "Such + be + Cụm danh từ + that..." nhấn mạnh mức độ lớn của danh từ ("Such was the inconsistency...").
explanation.en: "Such + be + noun phrase + that" is a formal inverted structure.

vocabItem.meaningVi: tuyên bố hủy phiên tòa để xét xử lại
vocabItem.example: Procedural misconduct forced the judge to declare a mistrial.

questions.stem: 8. Although the start-up’s valuation looked dazzling on paper, seasoned venture capitalists quickly realized it was all _______ and no substance.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: B — "smoke and mirrors"] "Smoke and mirrors" = trò ảo thuật che mắt, sự đánh bóng hào nhoáng nhưng rỗng tuếch nhằm che giấu sự thật.
explanation.en: "Smoke and mirrors" refers to the obscuring or embellishing of the truth with misleading information.

vocabItem.meaningVi: trò hào nhoáng đánh lừa thị giác, sự che mắt
vocabItem.example: The company’s financial recovery was nothing more than smoke and mirrors.

questions.stem: 9. When the investigative journalist confronted the senator with the leaked offshore ledgers, he was completely _______ for an explanation.

explanation.rule: C1/C2 Idiom: "be at a loss for words / an explanation"
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: D — "at a loss"] "Be at a loss (for an explanation/words)" = hoàn toàn lúng túng, bối rối không biết phải giải thích hay nói gì.
explanation.en: To be at a loss means to be unable to know what to do or say.

vocabItem.meaningVi: cứng họng, bối rối không biết nói gì
vocabItem.example: Confronted with the evidence, the official was at a loss for an explanation.

questions.stem: 10. Rather than addressing the systemic roots of inflation, the cabinet’s latest fiscal package merely _______ the cracks.

explanation.rule: C2 Phrasal Verb / Idiom: "paper over the cracks"
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: A — "papers over"] "Paper over the cracks" = che đậy tạm bợ những rạn nứt/khuyết điểm nghiêm trọng mà không giải quyết tận gốc.
explanation.en: To paper over the cracks means to conceal flaws or difficulties rather than resolving them.

vocabItem.meaningVi: vá víu, che đậy tạm thời các khuyết điểm
vocabItem.example: Short-term subsidies merely paper over the cracks in the healthcare system.

questions.stem: 11. By refusing to compromise on tariff reductions, the trade delegation effectively _______ its own diplomatic allies.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: C — "alienated"] "Alienate" = làm xa lánh, làm mất lòng các đồng minh/người ủng hộ.
explanation.en: To alienate means to cause someone to feel isolated or estranged.

vocabItem.meaningVi: làm mất lòng / đẩy đồng minh ra xa
vocabItem.example: The unilateral policy alienated long-standing diplomatic allies.

questions.stem: 12. The whistleblower’s testimony _______ the official narrative that the chemical spill had been contained within hours.

explanation.rule: C2 Idiom: "give the lie to something"
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: B — "gave the lie to"] "Give the lie to something" = vạch trần sự giả dối của điều gì, chứng minh điều gì là hoàn toàn sai sự thật.
explanation.en: To give the lie to something means to prove that a statement or assumption is false.

vocabItem.meaningVi: bác bỏ, vạch trần sự dối trá của
vocabItem.example: Satellite imagery gave the lie to claims that deforestation had slowed.

questions.stem: 13. Despite the dean’s eloquent assurances about academic freedom, many faculty members felt the administration was only _______.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: B — "paying lip service"] "Pay lip service" = ủng hộ đầu môi chót lưỡi (nói lời hoa mỹ nhưng không có hành động thực chất).
explanation.en: To pay lip service is to express approval or support insincerely without taking significant action.

vocabItem.meaningVi: ủng hộ suông, nói đầu môi chót lưỡi
vocabItem.example: Corporations often pay lip service to sustainability.

questions.stem: 14. After three grueling rounds of cross-examination, the defense attorney finally managed to _______ the prosecution’s star witness.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: C — "trip up"] "Trip somebody up" = gài bẫy làm ai đó nói hớ hoặc mắc lỗi trong lúc thẩm vấn/tranh biện. Shore up = củng cố; flesh out = bổ sung chi tiết; bog down = làm sa lầy.
explanation.en: To trip someone up means to cause them to make a mistake or reveal a contradiction.

vocabItem.meaningVi: làm ai đó nói hớ / vấp lỗi
vocabItem.example: The interviewer tried to trip the candidate up with technical questions.

questions.stem: 15. The central bank’s emergency liquidity injection was designed to _______ confidence in the beleaguered commercial banking sector.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: D — "shore up"] "Shore up" = chống đỡ, củng cố một hệ thống hoặc niềm tin đang suy yếu.
explanation.en: To shore up means to support or strengthen something that is weak or declining.

vocabItem.meaningVi: củng cố, vực dậy niềm tin
vocabItem.example: The rate cut failed to shore up investor confidence.

parts.title: Part 2: Word Formation — Academic Derivatives (Câu 16–25)
parts.instructions: Use the word given in capitals at the end of each sentence to form a word that fits in the space.

questions.stem: 16. The fire destroyed _______ medieval tapestries that had hung in the cathedral for six centuries. (PLACE)

explanation.vi: Giữ nguyên chữ "e" sau "c" để phát âm /s/: IRREPLACEABLE (vô giá, không thể thay thế được).
explanation.en: PLACE -> REPLACE -> IRREPLACEABLE (impossible to replace if lost or damaged).

vocabItem.meaningVi: di sản vô giá không thể thay thế
vocabItem.example: The flood damaged irreplaceable historical manuscripts.

questions.stem: 17. Crustal tectonic plates shift at an _______ slow pace of a few millimeters per year. (PERCEIVE)

explanation.rule: Verb to Negative Adverb: PERCEIVE → IMPERCEPTIBLY
explanation.vi: Trước tính từ "slow" cần một trạng từ: PERCEIVE -> PERCEPTIBLE -> IMPERCEPTIBLY (một cách cực nhỏ khó nhận thấy bằng giác quan).
explanation.en: PERCEIVE -> IMPERCEPTIBLY (in a way that is so slight or gradual as not to be perceived).

vocabItem.meaningVi: chậm đến mức khó nhận biết được
vocabItem.example: The glacier moved imperceptibly down the valley.

questions.stem: 18. The Stradivarius violin possesses an _______ tonal richness that modern luthiers still struggle to replicate. (COMPARE)

explanation.rule: Verb to Negative Adjective: COMPARE → INCOMPARABLE
explanation.vi: Sau mạo từ "an" cần tính từ: INCOMPARABLE (tuyệt vời, vô song không gì sánh kịp).
explanation.en: COMPARE -> INCOMPARABLE (without an equal in quality or extent; matchless).

vocabItem.meaningVi: sự phong phú vô song không gì sánh bằng
vocabItem.example: She performed with incomparable grace.

questions.stem: 19. Attempts to impose rigid price ceilings _______ lead to supply shortages and black-market speculation. (VARY)

explanation.rule: Verb to Negative Adverb: VARY → INVARIABLY
explanation.vi: Cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ "lead": INVARIABLY (luôn luôn, hầu như không bao giờ có ngoại lệ).
explanation.en: VARY -> INVARIABLY (in every case or on every occasion; always).

vocabItem.meaningVi: luôn luôn dẫn đến (không có ngoại lệ)
vocabItem.example: Hasty legislation invariably leads to unintended loopholes.

questions.stem: 20. The leaked recordings inflicted _______ damage on the prime minister’s credibility. (REPAIR)

explanation.rule: Vowel Reduction in Root: REPAIR → IRREPARABLE
explanation.vi: Bẫy chính tả: REPAIR bỏ chữ "i" khi thêm "-able" -> IRREPARABLE (không thể cứu vãn/khắc phục được).
explanation.en: REPAIR -> IRREPARABLE (impossible to rectify or repair).

vocabItem.meaningVi: gây tổn hại không thể cứu vãn
vocabItem.example: Oil spills inflict irreparable damage on marine ecosystems.

questions.stem: 21. From an ethical standpoint, exploiting child labor in global supply chains is utterly _______. (DEFEND)

explanation.vi: DEFEND đổi "-d" thành "-sible" -> INDEFENSIBLE (không thể bào chữa hay biện minh được).
explanation.en: DEFEND -> INDEFENSIBLE (not justifiable by argument).

vocabItem.meaningVi: không thể bào chữa về mặt đạo đức
vocabItem.example: Such negligence is morally indefensible.

questions.stem: 22. The rapid melting of permafrost has triggered an _______ release of ancient methane reserves. (PRECEDE)

explanation.rule: Negative Prefix + Participial Adjective: PRECEDE → UNPRECEDENTED
explanation.vi: Cần tính từ đứng trước danh từ "release": UNPRECEDENTED (chưa từng có tiền lệ).
explanation.en: PRECEDE -> UNPRECEDENTED (adjective: never done or known before).

vocabItem.meaningVi: sự giải phóng chưa từng có tiền lệ
vocabItem.example: The crisis prompted an unprecedented fiscal response.

questions.stem: 23. The inquiry demanded an _______ condemnation of algorithmic discrimination from the board of directors. (EQUIVOCATE)

explanation.rule: Verb to Negative Adjective: EQUIVOCATE → UNEQUIVOCAL
explanation.vi: Sau mạo từ "an" và trước danh từ "condemnation" cần tính từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm: UNEQUIVOCAL (dứt khoát, rõ ràng, không lập lờ).
explanation.en: EQUIVOCATE -> UNEQUIVOCAL (leaving no doubt; unambiguous).

vocabItem.meaningVi: sự lên án dứt khoát, không mập mờ
vocabItem.example: The council issued an unequivocal condemnation of the attack.

questions.stem: 24. Regressive consumption taxes _______ burden low-income households who spend most of their earnings on essentials. (PROPORTION)

explanation.rule: Noun to Negative Adverb: PROPORTION → DISPROPORTIONATELY
explanation.vi: Cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ "burden": DISPROPORTIONATELY (một cách bất cân xứng).
explanation.en: PROPORTION -> DISPROPORTIONATELY (to an extent that is too large or too small in comparison).

vocabItem.meaningVi: đè nặng một cách bất cân xứng lên
vocabItem.example: Inflation disproportionately burdens low-income families.

questions.stem: 25. The tribunal dismissed the allegations as wholly _______ rumours lacking any forensic corroboration. (SUBSTANCE)

explanation.rule: Noun to Participial Adjective: SUBSTANCE → UNSUBSTANTIATED
explanation.vi: Cần tính từ bổ nghĩa cho "rumours": UNSUBSTANTIATED (không có căn cứ, chưa được chứng minh).
explanation.en: SUBSTANCE -> SUBSTANTIATE -> UNSUBSTANTIATED (not supported or proven by evidence).

vocabItem.meaningVi: những cáo buộc vô căn cứ
vocabItem.example: The court rejected the unsubstantiated claims.

parts.title: Part 3: Error Identification & Correction (Câu 26–30)
parts.instructions: Identify the underlined part (A, B, C, or D) that contains a grammatical or lexical error and choose the correct fix.

questions.stem: 26. Identify the error: "The committee comprised of (A) twelve eminent epidemiologists who were tasked with (B) drafting (C) the national pandemic containment protocol (D)."

explanation.rule: Active Usage of "comprise" (No "of" in active voice)
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: A — "(A) comprised of -> comprised (or consisted of)"] Ở thể chủ động, "comprise" (= consist of) KHÔNG đi với giới từ "of". Chỉ dùng "be comprised of" hoặc "comprise + tân ngữ".
explanation.en: In standard formal English, active "comprise" does not take the preposition "of".

vocabItem.meaningVi: các nhà dịch tễ học lỗi lạc
vocabItem.example: The panel comprised twelve eminent epidemiologists.

questions.stem: 27. Identify the error: "Scarcely (A) the autonomous lander had touched (B) down on the lunar regolith when (C) its solar arrays malfunctioned (D)."

options.text: (B) the autonomous lander had touched -> had the autonomous lander touched

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: A — "(B) the autonomous lander had touched -> had the autonomous lander touched"] "Scarcely" đứng đầu câu bắt buộc đảo trợ động từ "had" lên trước chủ ngữ ("had the autonomous lander touched").
explanation.en: Fronted "Scarcely" requires inversion of the past perfect auxiliary "had".

vocabItem.meaningVi: lớp đất đá bề mặt Mặt Trăng
vocabItem.example: The rover collected samples of lunar regolith.

questions.stem: 28. Identify the error: "The regulatory agency insisted that the biotech startup (A) discloses (B) all adverse reactions observed (C) during Phase II trials (D)."

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: D — "(B) discloses -> disclose"] Sau "insisted that + S + V_bare", động từ phải ở dạng nguyên mẫu không chia ("disclose", không phải "discloses").
explanation.en: "Insist that" triggers the mandative subjunctive (bare infinitive "disclose").

vocabItem.meaningVi: các phản ứng phụ bất lợi
vocabItem.example: Patients were monitored for adverse reactions.

questions.stem: 29. Identify the error: "A large number of (A) empirical research (B) corroborates (C) the hypothesis that chronic sleep deprivation impairs neurogenesis (D)."

options.text: (A) A large number of -> A great deal of

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: B — "(A) A large number of -> A great deal of"] "Research" là danh từ KHÔNG đếm được nên không thể đi với "A large number of"; phải sửa thành "A great deal of" hoặc "A large body of".
explanation.en: "Research" is an uncountable noun and requires "a great deal of" or "a large body of".

vocabItem.meaningVi: củng cố / xác nhận một giả thuyết khoa học
vocabItem.example: Experimental data corroborated the hypothesis.

questions.stem: 30. Identify the error: "Not only the austerity measures exacerbated (A) urban unemployment, but they also (B) triggered (C) widespread civil unrest (D)."

options.text: (A) the austerity measures exacerbated -> did the austerity measures exacerbate

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: C — "(A) the austerity measures exacerbated -> did the austerity measures exacerbate"] Khi "Not only" đứng đầu câu bổ nghĩa cho cả mệnh đề, phải đảo trợ động từ: "Not only did the austerity measures exacerbate...".
explanation.en: Fronted clause-initial "Not only" requires subject-auxiliary inversion.

vocabItem.meaningVi: các biện pháp thắt lưng buộc bụng
vocabItem.example: Strict austerity measures sparked public protests.

reading.title: Section II: Reading Comprehension (26 câu hỏi)

parts.title: Part 1: Open Cloze — Cognitive Offloading & The "Google Effect" (Câu 31–40)
parts.instructions: Fill each of the numbered blanks (31–40) in the passage with ONE suitable word.
parts.passageTitle: The Epistemic Cost of Externalized Memory
parts.passage:
In contemporary cognitive science, few phenomena have provoked as much debate as the (31) {{31}} of external digital memory. Whereas human beings once relied (32) {{32}} internal hippocampal networks to encode and retrieve lived experience, the ubiquity of cloud-based search engines has fundamentally altered how we interact with knowledge. Rather (33) {{33}} memorizing facts themselves, modern learners increasingly remember merely where to locate information—a cognitive shortcut known as the "Google Effect."

While such offloading undeniably liberates working memory (34) {{34}} routine clerical tasks, neurobiologists warn that it comes at a steep epistemic (35) {{35}}. Deep conceptual creativity does not occur in a vacuum; (36) {{36}} the contrary, it depends on a dense internal web of schemas that can be cross-referenced spontaneously. (37) {{37}} students delegate this foundational synthesis to algorithmic tools, their capacity for critical discernment risks falling (38) {{38}} atrophy. Consequently, educators are called (39) {{39}} to design assessments that reward deep structural reasoning (40) {{40}} passive information retrieval.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (31): "...the (31) _______ of external digital memory."

explanation.vi: Điền "rise" / "advent" / "proliferation" (sự trỗi dậy/xuất hiện của bộ nhớ số bên ngoài).
explanation.en: The rise/advent of external digital memory.

vocabItem.meaningVi: sự ra đời / xuất hiện của
vocabItem.example: The advent of cloud computing transformed education.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (32): "...relied (32) _______ internal hippocampal networks..."

explanation.vi: Cấu trúc "rely on / upon" (dựa vào mạng lưới hồi hải mã bên trong).
explanation.en: Rely takes the preposition on or upon.

vocabItem.meaningVi: dựa vào, phụ thuộc vào
vocabItem.example: Scholars relied upon archival indices.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (33): "Rather (33) _______ memorizing facts themselves..."

explanation.vi: Cụm liên từ "Rather than + V-ing" (Thay vì tự ghi nhớ dữ kiện).
explanation.en: Rather than introduces a rejected alternative.

vocabItem.meaningVi: thay vì
vocabItem.example: Rather than memorizing dates, analyze the causes.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (34): "...liberates working memory (34) _______ routine clerical tasks..."

explanation.vi: Cấu trúc "liberate somebody/something from..." (giải phóng trí nhớ làm việc khỏi các tác vụ lặt vặt).
explanation.en: Liberate collocates with the preposition from.

vocabItem.meaningVi: giải phóng khỏi
vocabItem.example: Automation liberated workers from repetitive tasks.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (35): "...it comes at a steep epistemic (35) _______."

explanation.vi: Thành ngữ "come at a steep cost/price" (phải trả một cái giá đắt về mặt nhận thức).
explanation.en: To come at a steep cost/price means to involve a heavy sacrifice.

vocabItem.meaningVi: phải trả một cái giá rất đắt
vocabItem.example: Convenience often comes at a steep epistemic cost.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (36): "...(36) _______ the contrary, it depends on..."

explanation.vi: Cụm chuyển ý tương phản "on the contrary" (trái lại, ngược lại hoàn toàn).
explanation.en: "On the contrary" intensifies denial of the preceding negative statement.

vocabItem.meaningVi: trái lại, ngược lại hoàn toàn
vocabItem.example: Creativity is not random; on the contrary, it is disciplined.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (37): "(37) _______ students delegate this foundational synthesis..."

explanation.vi: Điền liên từ "When / Whenever / Once / If" mở đầu mệnh đề phụ chỉ điều kiện/thời gian.
explanation.en: When/Once introduces the conditional-temporal clause.

vocabItem.meaningVi: ủy thác việc tổng hợp tri thức cho
vocabItem.example: When learners delegate synthesis to AI, retention drops.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (38): "...risks falling (38) _______ atrophy."

explanation.vi: Cụm cố định "fall into atrophy / decline" (rơi vào trạng thái suy thoái / mai một).
explanation.en: "Fall into atrophy/disuse" is a fixed formal collocation.

vocabItem.meaningVi: rơi vào trạng thái thoái hóa / mai một
vocabItem.example: Unused cognitive faculties quickly fall into atrophy.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (39): "...educators are called (39) _______ to design assessments..."

explanation.rule: Phrasal Verb: "be called upon/on to do something"
explanation.vi: "Be called upon/on to V" = được kêu gọi, được yêu cầu thực hiện trọng trách.
explanation.en: To be called upon to do something means to be formally asked or required to do it.

vocabItem.meaningVi: được kêu gọi / giao trọng trách làm gì
vocabItem.example: Educators are called upon to foster critical inquiry.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (40): "...reward deep structural reasoning (40) _______ passive information retrieval."

explanation.rule: Preposition of Preference: "reward/prioritize A over B"
explanation.vi: Cấu trúc "reward/prioritize A over B" (đề cao tư duy cấu trúc sâu hơn là việc truy xuất thụ động).
explanation.en: "Over" expresses preference or priority between two competing approaches.

vocabItem.meaningVi: ưu tiên chiều sâu hơn tốc độ
vocabItem.example: The rubric rewards analytical depth over rote recall.

parts.title: Part 2: Guided Cloze — The Paradox of Green Gentrification (Câu 41–50)
parts.instructions: Read the passage below and decide which answer (A, B, C, or D) best fits each gap.
parts.passageTitle: Ecological Urbanism & Socioeconomic Displacement
parts.passage:
The contemporary resurgence of "ecological urbanism" has been widely lauded as a panacea for post-industrial cities. Municipal authorities across the globe have poured billions into converting derelict rail corridors into elevated botanical promenades. Yet urban sociologists warn that such initiatives frequently (41) _______ a troubling paradox known as "green gentrification." While newly landscaped districts undeniably (42) _______ ambient air quality and bolster municipal tax revenues, they simultaneously trigger speculative real-estate bubbles that price out long-standing working-class residents.

In the absence of robust rent-stabilization mandates, environmental remediation inadvertently becomes an instrument of socioeconomic exclusion. What appears (43) _______ progressive on architectural blueprints often (44) _______ vulnerable demographics to the under-resourced urban periphery. Rather than dismantling spatial inequality, poorly calibrated interventions risk (45) _______ existing class divides. Furthermore, the post-pandemic (46) _______ of remote work has disproportionately benefited affluent knowledge workers, whereas essential service personnel remain (47) _______ to grueling cross-city commutes. Reconciling ecological vitality with housing equity therefore (48) _______ a fundamental departure from market-led redevelopment. Only when municipalities anchor green infrastructure within statutory community land trusts can urban renewal avoid becoming a (49) _______ for displacement and instead foster genuine civic (50) _______.

questions.stem: Question 41: Choose the best word for blank (41) in the Guided Cloze passage:

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: C — "engender"] "Engender a paradox" = làm nảy sinh, tạo ra một nghịch lý.
explanation.en: To engender means to cause or give rise to a feeling, situation, or condition.

vocabItem.meaningVi: làm nảy sinh một nghịch lý
vocabItem.example: Green urbanism can inadvertently engender a social paradox.

questions.stem: Question 42: Choose the best word for blank (42) in the Guided Cloze passage:

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: D — "ameliorate"] "Ameliorate" = cải thiện, làm cho tốt hơn (chất lượng không khí/điều kiện sống).
explanation.en: To ameliorate means to make something bad or unsatisfactory better.

vocabItem.meaningVi: cải thiện chất lượng không khí
vocabItem.example: Urban canopies help ameliorate ambient air quality.

questions.stem: Question 43: Choose the best word for blank (43) in the Guided Cloze passage:

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: A — "ostensibly"] "Ostensibly" = bề ngoài có vẻ là (nhưng thực tế ẩn chứa mặt trái).
explanation.en: Ostensibly means apparently or purportedly, though perhaps not actually.

vocabItem.meaningVi: bề ngoài có vẻ tiến bộ
vocabItem.example: The policy was ostensibly progressive but regressive in practice.

questions.stem: Question 44: Choose the best word for blank (44) in the Guided Cloze passage:

explanation.rule: C2 Verb Structure: "relegate A to the periphery"
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: B — "relegates"] "Relegate someone to the periphery" = đẩy nhóm yếu thế ra vùng ven đô.
explanation.en: To relegate means to consign to an inferior or marginalized position.

vocabItem.meaningVi: đẩy ra vùng rìa / ven đô
vocabItem.example: Rising rents relegated low-income workers to the periphery.

questions.stem: Question 45: Choose the best word for blank (45) in the Guided Cloze passage:

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: D — "entrenching"] "Entrench existing class divides" = làm bám rễ sâu hơn sự phân hóa giai cấp.
explanation.en: To entrench means to establish a division so firmly that change is very difficult.

vocabItem.meaningVi: khoét sâu thêm sự phân hóa giai cấp
vocabItem.example: Uncalibrated subsidies risk entrenching class divides.

questions.stem: Question 46: Choose the best word for blank (46) in the Guided Cloze passage:

explanation.rule: C2 Noun: "the proliferation of remote work"
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: A — "proliferation"] "The proliferation of remote work" = sự bùng nổ/lan rộng của hình thức làm việc từ xa.
explanation.en: Proliferation refers to rapid multiplication or widespread expansion.

vocabItem.meaningVi: sự bùng nổ lan rộng của
vocabItem.example: The proliferation of remote work reshaped urban transit.

questions.stem: Question 47: Choose the best word for blank (47) in the Guided Cloze passage:

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: C — "tethered"] "Remain tethered to" = vẫn bị trói buộc chặt vào những chuyến đi làm xa vất vả.
explanation.en: Tethered to means bound or tied closely to a constraint.

vocabItem.meaningVi: bị trói buộc chặt vào
vocabItem.example: Service workers remain tethered to physical workplaces.

questions.stem: Question 48: Choose the best word for blank (48) in the Guided Cloze passage:

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: B — "necessitates"] "Necessitates" = đòi hỏi tất yếu một sự thay đổi căn bản.
explanation.en: To necessitate means to make something necessary as a result or consequence.

vocabItem.meaningVi: đòi hỏi phải từ bỏ lối mòn cũ
vocabItem.example: Climate resilience necessitates a departure from laissez-faire urbanism.

questions.stem: Question 49: Choose the best word for blank (49) in the Guided Cloze passage:

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: B — "catalyst"] "A catalyst for displacement" = chất xúc tác thúc đẩy sự di dời cư dân nghèo.
explanation.en: A catalyst is an agent that provokes or speeds significant change.

vocabItem.meaningVi: tác nhân thúc đẩy sự đẩy đuổi cư dân
vocabItem.example: Speculative zoning acted as a catalyst for displacement.

questions.stem: Question 50: Choose the best word for blank (50) in the Guided Cloze passage:

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: C — "inclusivity"] "Civic inclusivity" = sự bao trùm, dung nạp công dân thuộc mọi tầng lớp.
explanation.en: Inclusivity is the practice of providing equal access to opportunities and resources.

vocabItem.meaningVi: sự dung hợp / công bằng cho mọi công dân
vocabItem.example: Public parks should foster genuine civic inclusivity.

parts.title: Part 3: Academic Reading — The Annales School & The Longue Durée (Câu 51–56)
parts.instructions: Read the following historiographical extract and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for questions 51–56.
parts.passageTitle: Beyond the "Great Man": Braudel, Microhistory, and Structural Agency
parts.passage:
Paragraph 1: For much of the twentieth century, historiography was dominated by the "Great Man" paradigm, which posited that epochal shifts in human civilization were chiefly the handiwork of charismatic statesmen, military commanders, and solitary scientific geniuses. However, the rise of the Annales school in France fundamentally subverted this event-centric orthodoxy. Pioneered by Marc Bloch and Fernand Braudel, this movement contended that political drama is merely the "crest of foam" riding upon deeper, slower currents of geographical constraint, demographic pressure, and collective mentalities—what Braudel memorably termed the longue durée.

Paragraph 2: Viewed through the prism of the longue durée, the fall of empires or the eruption of revolutions can rarely be attributed to the caprice of a single monarch. Instead, such ruptures represent the culmination of centuries-long structural stresses: soil exhaustion, shifting trade winds, monetarist inflation, or agrarian demographic ceilings. While traditional chroniclers fixated on diplomatic treaties signed in gilded palaces, structural historians turned their gaze toward parish registries, grain price ledgers, and dendrochronological ice cores.

Paragraph 3: Yet in recent decades, critics have cautioned against swinging the pendulum too far toward geographic or economic determinism. By reducing human beings to passive marionettes of climatic and material forces, extreme structuralism risks erasing moral agency and ideological contingency. Contemporary "microhistory" seeks to synthesize both scales: examining how ordinary artisans, dissidents, and marginalized communities navigated, resisted, and occasionally reshaped the macro-structural constraints of their era.

questions.stem: Question 51: What is the primary purpose of Paragraph 1?

options.text: To criticize Fernand Braudel for ignoring geographical constraints.
To argue that military commanders played no role in twentieth-century geopolitics.
To chronicle the biographical rivalry between Marc Bloch and traditional diplomats.
To contrast traditional individual-centered history with the structural approach of the Annales school.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: D — "To contrast traditional individual-centered history with the structural approach of the Annales school."] Đoạn 1 đối chiếu hệ hình "Vĩ nhân" truyền thống với trường phái Annales chú trọng cấu trúc dài hạn (longue durée).
explanation.en: Paragraph 1 contrasts the Great Man paradigm with the structural Annales school.

vocabItem.meaningVi: lật đổ một quan niệm chính thống cũ
vocabItem.example: The Annales school subverted event-centric orthodoxy.

questions.stem: Question 52: In Paragraph 1, what does Braudel’s metaphor "crest of foam" imply about political events?

options.text: They are superficial manifestations of much deeper, long-term structural forces.
They occur exclusively in maritime empires.
They are the primary driving force behind climatic and demographic change.
They are completely fabricated by biased court chroniclers.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: A — "They are superficial manifestations of much deeper, long-term structural forces."] Hình ảnh "bọt sóng trên ngọn" (crest of foam) ám chỉ các sự kiện chính trị chỉ là biểu hiện bề mặt của những dòng chảy cấu trúc sâu thẳm bên dưới.
explanation.en: Political drama is portrayed as surface-level compared to deep structural currents.

vocabItem.meaningVi: nhịp thời gian cấu trúc trường kỳ trong sử học
vocabItem.example: Braudel analyzed Mediterranean history through the longue durée.

questions.stem: Question 53: The word "caprice" in Paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to:

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: A — "impulsive whim"] "Caprice" = sự thất thường, ý thích bốc đồng nhất thời (= impulsive whim).
explanation.en: Caprice means a sudden and unaccountable change of mood or behavior; a whim.

vocabItem.meaningVi: sự thất thường / ý muốn bốc đồng của
vocabItem.example: History cannot be explained by the caprice of monarchs.

questions.stem: Question 54: Why did structural historians examine "grain price ledgers and dendrochronological ice cores" (Paragraph 2)?

options.text: To replace historical writing with pure geological science.
To prove that agriculture was more profitable than maritime trade.
To verify the exact dates when diplomatic treaties were signed in palaces.
To reconstruct long-term material, economic, and environmental pressures on societies.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: D — "To reconstruct long-term material, economic, and environmental pressures on societies."] Các sử gia cấu trúc nghiên cứu sổ giá ngũ cốc và lõi băng để tái dựng các áp lực vật chất, kinh tế và khí hậu dài hạn.
explanation.en: Such empirical sources reveal centuries-long structural stresses.

vocabItem.meaningVi: những sức ép mang tính cấu trúc
vocabItem.example: Revolutions often stem from centuries-long structural stresses.

questions.stem: Question 55: According to Paragraph 3, what is the main criticism leveled against extreme structuralism?

options.text: It ignores the impact of soil exhaustion and inflation.
It risks stripping individuals of moral responsibility and historical agency.
It places excessive emphasis on the biographies of solitary geniuses.
It relies too heavily on unreliable oral traditions.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: B — "It risks stripping individuals of moral responsibility and historical agency."] Đoạn 3 chỉ rõ: chủ nghĩa cấu trúc cực đoan biến con người thành "con rối thụ động" và xóa nhòa năng lực hành động đạo đức (moral agency).
explanation.en: Extreme structuralism risks erasing moral agency and ideological contingency.

vocabItem.meaningVi: năng lực tự chủ và chịu trách nhiệm đạo đức
vocabItem.example: Determinism risks erasing human moral agency.

questions.stem: Question 56: How does contemporary "microhistory" resolve the tension described in the passage?

options.text: By returning exclusively to the study of monarchs and military generals.
By abandoning archival research in favor of computer simulations.
By exploring how ordinary people actively negotiated and resisted large-scale structural constraints.
By proving that geography has zero influence on human culture.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: C — "By exploring how ordinary people actively negotiated and resisted large-scale structural constraints."] Vi sử học (microhistory) dung hòa cả hai cấp độ bằng cách khảo sát cách những con người bình thường xoay xở, phản kháng và định hình lại các ràng buộc cấu trúc vĩ mô.
explanation.en: Microhistory synthesizes both scales by studying how ordinary people navigated macro-constraints.

vocabItem.meaningVi: tính ngẫu nhiên / biến số về mặt tư tưởng
vocabItem.example: Historians must account for ideological contingency.

writing.title: Section III: Writing & Use of English (4 câu + 2 bài luận)

parts.title: Part 1: Key Word Sentence Transformation (Câu 57–60)
parts.instructions: Complete the second sentence so that it has a similar meaning to the first sentence, using the word given.

questions.stem: 57. Rewrite using "ILLUSION": The minister was fully aware that the austerity package would provoke fierce union resistance.
questions.answer: The minister was under no illusion that the austerity package would provoke fierce union resistance.
acceptedAnswers: The minister was under no illusion that the austerity package would provoke fierce union resistance.
under no illusion that the austerity package would provoke fierce union resistance

explanation.vi: "Be under no illusion that..." = hoàn toàn nhận thức rõ thực tế phũ phàng rằng (không hề ảo tưởng).
explanation.en: To be under no illusion means to be fully aware of the true state of affairs.

vocabItem.meaningVi: không hề ảo tưởng, nhận thức rất rõ rằng
vocabItem.example: We are under no illusion about the scale of the challenge.

questions.stem: 58. Rewrite using "SHORT": Only a comprehensive overhaul of the judicial code will restore public trust.
questions.answer: Nothing short of a comprehensive overhaul of the judicial code will restore public trust.
acceptedAnswers: Nothing short of a comprehensive overhaul of the judicial code will restore public trust.
Nothing short of a comprehensive overhaul of the judicial code

explanation.rule: C2 Emphatic Structure: "Nothing short of + Noun Phrase"
explanation.vi: "Nothing short of..." = Chỉ có một cuộc cải tổ toàn diện mới... (Không gì ít hơn điều đó có thể đủ).
explanation.en: "Nothing short of" emphasizes that only an extreme or thorough measure will suffice.

vocabItem.meaningVi: chỉ có... mới đủ / chẳng khác gì
vocabItem.example: Nothing short of systemic reform will resolve the crisis.

questions.stem: 59. Rewrite using "PAR": The apprentice’s craftsmanship was just as exquisite as that of the master guildsman.
questions.answer: The apprentice’s craftsmanship was on a par with that of the master guildsman.
acceptedAnswers: The apprentice’s craftsmanship was on a par with that of the master guildsman.
on a par with that of the master guildsman

explanation.rule: C2 Idiom: "be on a par with"
explanation.vi: "Be on a par with somebody/something" = ngang tầm, sánh ngang về chất lượng/đẳng cấp với.
explanation.en: To be on a par with means to be equal in importance or quality to.

vocabItem.meaningVi: ngang tầm / sánh ngang với
vocabItem.example: Local research output is now on a par with international benchmarks.

questions.stem: 60. Rewrite using "BRUNT": Small coastal communities suffered the worst impact of the supply-chain disruption.
questions.answer: Small coastal communities bore the brunt of the supply-chain disruption.
acceptedAnswers: Small coastal communities bore the brunt of the supply-chain disruption.
bore the brunt of the supply-chain disruption

explanation.vi: "Bear the brunt of something" = gánh chịu mũi nhọn / phần thiệt hại nặng nề nhất của một biến cố.
explanation.en: To bear the brunt of something is to suffer the worst part of an unpleasant or problematic situation.

vocabItem.meaningVi: gánh chịu hậu quả nặng nề nhất của
vocabItem.example: Frontline workers bore the brunt of the pandemic.

exams.province_school: THPT Chuyên Hạ Long – Quảng Ninh

parts.title: Part 1: Multiple Choice — Inversion, Subjunctive, Idioms & Confusable Lexis (Câu 1–15)
parts.instructions: Choose the best option (A, B, C, or D) to complete each of the following sentences.

questions.stem: 1. _______ the central bank to tighten monetary policy prematurely, the nascent post-recession recovery would grind to a halt.

explanation.rule: Inverted Conditional Type 2 with "Were + S + to V"
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: B — "Were"] Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 2 giả định tương lai ít có khả năng xảy ra: "Were + S + to V, S + would V" (= If the central bank were to tighten...).
explanation.en: "Were + subject + to-infinitive" forms an inverted second conditional.

vocabItem.meaningVi: ngừng trệ hoàn toàn
vocabItem.example: Industrial output ground to a halt during the crisis.

questions.stem: 2. Under no circumstances _______ to circumvent the cryptographic authentication protocols.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: C — "are external contractors permitted"] Cụm trạng ngữ phủ định "Under no circumstances" đứng đầu câu bắt buộc đảo trợ động từ/be lên trước chủ ngữ ("are external contractors permitted").
explanation.en: Negative restrictive phrases at the beginning of a clause trigger inversion.

vocabItem.meaningVi: lách qua / vượt trái phép các giao thức
vocabItem.example: No employee is allowed to circumvent security protocols.

questions.stem: 3. Hardly _______ the podium when a barrage of incisive questions erupted from the parliamentary opposition.

explanation.rule: Correlative Inversion: "Hardly + had + S + V3/ed + when..."
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: D — "had the Chancellormounted"] Cấu trúc "Hardly/Scarcely + had + S + Vp2 + when + S + V_ed" diễn tả hành động vừa mới xảy ra thì hành động khác ập đến.
explanation.en: Hardly/Scarcely... when requires past perfect inversion in the first clause.

vocabItem.meaningVi: một tràng câu hỏi dồn dập
vocabItem.example: The minister faced a barrage of incisive questions.

questions.stem: 4. _______ as it may seem to laypeople, quantum entanglement allows particles to correlate instantaneously across vast cosmic distances.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: A — "Counterintuitive"] Cấu trúc nhượng bộ C1/C2: "Adj + as/though + S + linking verb (seem/be/appear)" = Although it may seem counterintuitive. Không dùng "However" khi đã có "as".
explanation.en: Fronted adjective + as/though expresses concession.

vocabItem.meaningVi: ngược với trực giác thông thường
vocabItem.example: Counterintuitive as it may seem, higher road capacity can increase congestion.

questions.stem: 5. So entrenched _______ within the municipal bureaucracy that three successive reform commissions failed to uproot it.

explanation.rule: Inversion with "So + Adj + be + S + that..."
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: A — "was institutional patronage"] Khi "So + tính từ" được đảo lên đầu câu để nhấn mạnh mức độ, động từ "be" phải đảo lên trước chủ ngữ ("was institutional patronage").
explanation.en: Fronted "So + adjective" triggers subject-verb inversion.

vocabItem.meaningVi: chủ nghĩa thân hữu / nâng đỡ trong bộ máy
vocabItem.example: The reform aimed to dismantle institutional patronage.

questions.stem: 6. It is imperative that every autonomous vehicle _______ rigorous adversarial stress-testing before public deployment.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: D — "undergo"] Sau cấu trúc giả định "It is imperative that + S + V_bare", dùng động từ nguyên mẫu không "es" ("undergo").
explanation.en: Adjectives of urgency trigger the bare infinitive subjunctive.

vocabItem.meaningVi: trải qua kiểm thử chịu tải khắc nghiệt
vocabItem.example: Banks must undergo rigorous stress-testing.

questions.stem: 7. Little _______ that their seemingly innocuous metadata was being aggregated into psychometric voter profiles.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: B — "did the platform users suspect"] "Little" mang nghĩa phủ định đứng đầu câu cùng các động từ nhận thức (know, realize, suspect, imagine) bắt buộc đảo trợ động từ ("did the platform users suspect").
explanation.en: Fronted restrictive "Little" requires auxiliary inversion.

vocabItem.meaningVi: bề ngoài có vẻ vô hại
vocabItem.example: Seemingly innocuous comments can conceal deep bias.

questions.stem: 8. Only by decoupling industrial productivity from fossil-fuel extraction _______ hope to avert irreversible biosphere tipping points.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: C — "can humanity"] Khi "Only by + V-ing" đứng đầu câu, mệnh đề chính phải đảo trợ động từ/modal verb lên trước chủ ngữ ("can humanity hope").
explanation.en: "Only by..." at the start of a sentence triggers inversion in the matrix clause.

vocabItem.meaningVi: các ngưỡng tới hạn của sinh quyển
vocabItem.example: Scientists warn of irreversible biosphere tipping points.

questions.stem: 9. _______ the archival manuscripts not been hermetically sealed in nitrogen vaults, theink would have oxidized centuries ago.

explanation.rule: Inverted Third Conditional ("Had + S + not + Vp2")
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: C — "Had"] Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 3 ở thể phủ định: "Had + S + not + been + Vp2" (chữ "not" luôn đứng sau chủ ngữ, không viết Hadn’t).
explanation.en: Inverted third conditional places "Had" before the subject and "not" after the subject.

vocabItem.meaningVi: được niêm phong kín tuyệt đối
vocabItem.example: The artifacts were kept in hermetically sealed chambers.

questions.stem: 10. Such _______ of the witnesses’ testimonies that the presiding judge declared an immediate mistrial.

explanation.rule: Inversion with "Such + be + Noun Phrase + that..."
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: D — "was the inconsistency"] Cấu trúc "Such + be + Cụm danh từ + that..." nhấn mạnh mức độ lớn của danh từ ("Such was the inconsistency...").
explanation.en: "Such + be + noun phrase + that" is a formal inverted structure.

vocabItem.meaningVi: tuyên bố hủy phiên tòa để xét xử lại
vocabItem.example: Procedural misconduct forced the judge to declare a mistrial.

questions.stem: 11. Although the start-up’s valuation looked dazzling on paper, seasoned venture capitalists quickly realized it was all _______ and no substance.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: A — "smoke and mirrors"] "Smoke and mirrors" = trò ảo thuật che mắt, sự đánh bóng hào nhoáng nhưng rỗng tuếch nhằm che giấu sự thật.
explanation.en: "Smoke and mirrors" refers to the obscuring or embellishing of the truth with misleading information.

vocabItem.meaningVi: trò hào nhoáng đánh lừa thị giác, sự che mắt
vocabItem.example: The company’s financial recovery was nothing more than smoke and mirrors.

questions.stem: 12. When the investigative journalist confronted the senator with the leaked offshore ledgers, he was completely _______ for an explanation.

explanation.rule: C1/C2 Idiom: "be at a loss for words / an explanation"
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: B — "at a loss"] "Be at a loss (for an explanation/words)" = hoàn toàn lúng túng, bối rối không biết phải giải thích hay nói gì.
explanation.en: To be at a loss means to be unable to know what to do or say.

vocabItem.meaningVi: cứng họng, bối rối không biết nói gì
vocabItem.example: Confronted with the evidence, the official was at a loss for an explanation.

questions.stem: 13. Rather than addressing the systemic roots of inflation, the cabinet’s latest fiscal package merely _______ the cracks.

explanation.rule: C2 Phrasal Verb / Idiom: "paper over the cracks"
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: D — "papers over"] "Paper over the cracks" = che đậy tạm bợ những rạn nứt/khuyết điểm nghiêm trọng mà không giải quyết tận gốc.
explanation.en: To paper over the cracks means to conceal flaws or difficulties rather than resolving them.

vocabItem.meaningVi: vá víu, che đậy tạm thời các khuyết điểm
vocabItem.example: Short-term subsidies merely paper over the cracks in the healthcare system.

questions.stem: 14. By refusing to compromise on tariff reductions, the trade delegation effectively _______ its own diplomatic allies.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: A — "alienated"] "Alienate" = làm xa lánh, làm mất lòng các đồng minh/người ủng hộ.
explanation.en: To alienate means to cause someone to feel isolated or estranged.

vocabItem.meaningVi: làm mất lòng / đẩy đồng minh ra xa
vocabItem.example: The unilateral policy alienated long-standing diplomatic allies.

questions.stem: 15. The whistleblower’s testimony _______ the official narrative that the chemical spill had been contained within hours.

explanation.rule: C2 Idiom: "give the lie to something"
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: C — "gave the lie to"] "Give the lie to something" = vạch trần sự giả dối của điều gì, chứng minh điều gì là hoàn toàn sai sự thật.
explanation.en: To give the lie to something means to prove that a statement or assumption is false.

vocabItem.meaningVi: bác bỏ, vạch trần sự dối trá của
vocabItem.example: Satellite imagery gave the lie to claims that deforestation had slowed.

parts.title: Part 2: Word Formation — Academic Derivatives (Câu 16–25)
parts.instructions: Use the word given in capitals at the end of each sentence to form a word that fits in the space.

questions.stem: 16. Peer-reviewed replication remains an _______ cornerstone of the empirical scientific method. (DISPENSE)

explanation.rule: Verb to Negative Adjective: DISPENSE → INDISPENSABLE
explanation.vi: Sau mạo từ "an" cần tính từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm: INDISPENSABLE (tối quan trọng, không thể thiếu). Lưu ý đuôi "-able".
explanation.en: DISPENSE -> INDISPENSABLE (absolutely necessary).

vocabItem.meaningVi: nền tảng tối quan trọng không thể thiếu
vocabItem.example: Trust is an indispensable cornerstone of diplomacy.

questions.stem: 17. For reasons that remain _______ to marine biologists, the entire pod of whales strayed into shallow coastal waters. (EXPLAIN)

explanation.vi: EXPLAIN biến đổi gốc Latin thành "-plic-" -> INEXPLICABLE (không thể lý giải được). Không dùng "unexplainable" trong văn phong C2.
explanation.en: EXPLAIN -> INEXPLICABLE (unable to be explained or accounted for).

vocabItem.meaningVi: vẫn không thể lý giải được
vocabItem.example: The sudden disappearance remained inexplicable.

questions.stem: 18. The fire destroyed _______ medieval tapestries that had hung in the cathedral for six centuries. (PLACE)

explanation.vi: Giữ nguyên chữ "e" sau "c" để phát âm /s/: IRREPLACEABLE (vô giá, không thể thay thế được).
explanation.en: PLACE -> REPLACE -> IRREPLACEABLE (impossible to replace if lost or damaged).

vocabItem.meaningVi: di sản vô giá không thể thay thế
vocabItem.example: The flood damaged irreplaceable historical manuscripts.

questions.stem: 19. Crustal tectonic plates shift at an _______ slow pace of a few millimeters per year. (PERCEIVE)

explanation.rule: Verb to Negative Adverb: PERCEIVE → IMPERCEPTIBLY
explanation.vi: Trước tính từ "slow" cần một trạng từ: PERCEIVE -> PERCEPTIBLE -> IMPERCEPTIBLY (một cách cực nhỏ khó nhận thấy bằng giác quan).
explanation.en: PERCEIVE -> IMPERCEPTIBLY (in a way that is so slight or gradual as not to be perceived).

vocabItem.meaningVi: chậm đến mức khó nhận biết được
vocabItem.example: The glacier moved imperceptibly down the valley.

questions.stem: 20. The Stradivarius violin possesses an _______ tonal richness that modern luthiers still struggle to replicate. (COMPARE)

explanation.rule: Verb to Negative Adjective: COMPARE → INCOMPARABLE
explanation.vi: Sau mạo từ "an" cần tính từ: INCOMPARABLE (tuyệt vời, vô song không gì sánh kịp).
explanation.en: COMPARE -> INCOMPARABLE (without an equal in quality or extent; matchless).

vocabItem.meaningVi: sự phong phú vô song không gì sánh bằng
vocabItem.example: She performed with incomparable grace.

questions.stem: 21. Attempts to impose rigid price ceilings _______ lead to supply shortages and black-market speculation. (VARY)

explanation.rule: Verb to Negative Adverb: VARY → INVARIABLY
explanation.vi: Cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ "lead": INVARIABLY (luôn luôn, hầu như không bao giờ có ngoại lệ).
explanation.en: VARY -> INVARIABLY (in every case or on every occasion; always).

vocabItem.meaningVi: luôn luôn dẫn đến (không có ngoại lệ)
vocabItem.example: Hasty legislation invariably leads to unintended loopholes.

questions.stem: 22. The leaked recordings inflicted _______ damage on the prime minister’s credibility. (REPAIR)

explanation.rule: Vowel Reduction in Root: REPAIR → IRREPARABLE
explanation.vi: Bẫy chính tả: REPAIR bỏ chữ "i" khi thêm "-able" -> IRREPARABLE (không thể cứu vãn/khắc phục được).
explanation.en: REPAIR -> IRREPARABLE (impossible to rectify or repair).

vocabItem.meaningVi: gây tổn hại không thể cứu vãn
vocabItem.example: Oil spills inflict irreparable damage on marine ecosystems.

questions.stem: 23. From an ethical standpoint, exploiting child labor in global supply chains is utterly _______. (DEFEND)

explanation.vi: DEFEND đổi "-d" thành "-sible" -> INDEFENSIBLE (không thể bào chữa hay biện minh được).
explanation.en: DEFEND -> INDEFENSIBLE (not justifiable by argument).

vocabItem.meaningVi: không thể bào chữa về mặt đạo đức
vocabItem.example: Such negligence is morally indefensible.

questions.stem: 24. The rapid melting of permafrost has triggered an _______ release of ancient methane reserves. (PRECEDE)

explanation.rule: Negative Prefix + Participial Adjective: PRECEDE → UNPRECEDENTED
explanation.vi: Cần tính từ đứng trước danh từ "release": UNPRECEDENTED (chưa từng có tiền lệ).
explanation.en: PRECEDE -> UNPRECEDENTED (adjective: never done or known before).

vocabItem.meaningVi: sự giải phóng chưa từng có tiền lệ
vocabItem.example: The crisis prompted an unprecedented fiscal response.

questions.stem: 25. The inquiry demanded an _______ condemnation of algorithmic discrimination from the board of directors. (EQUIVOCATE)

explanation.rule: Verb to Negative Adjective: EQUIVOCATE → UNEQUIVOCAL
explanation.vi: Sau mạo từ "an" và trước danh từ "condemnation" cần tính từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm: UNEQUIVOCAL (dứt khoát, rõ ràng, không lập lờ).
explanation.en: EQUIVOCATE -> UNEQUIVOCAL (leaving no doubt; unambiguous).

vocabItem.meaningVi: sự lên án dứt khoát, không mập mờ
vocabItem.example: The council issued an unequivocal condemnation of the attack.

parts.title: Part 3: Error Identification & Correction (Câu 26–30)
parts.instructions: Identify the underlined part (A, B, C, or D) that contains a grammatical or lexical error and choose the correct fix.

questions.stem: 26. Identify the error: "Having deprived (A) of sunlight for decades, the subterranean cave crustaceans evolved (B) heightened tactile receptors in lieu of (C) functional eyes (D)."

options.text: (C) in lieu of -> in spite of

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: B — "(A) Having deprived -> Having been deprived"] Chủ ngữ "crustaceans" (loài giáp xác) BỊ tước đoạt ánh sáng mặt trời -> phải dùng phân từ hoàn thành bị động "Having been deprived of".
explanation.en: Passive meaning requires the perfect passive participle "Having been deprived".

vocabItem.meaningVi: thay vì, thay thế cho
vocabItem.example: They accepted equity in lieu of cash payment.

questions.stem: 27. Identify the error: "The committee comprised of (A) twelve eminent epidemiologists who were tasked with (B) drafting (C) the national pandemic containment protocol (D)."

explanation.rule: Active Usage of "comprise" (No "of" in active voice)
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: B — "(A) comprised of -> comprised (or consisted of)"] Ở thể chủ động, "comprise" (= consist of) KHÔNG đi với giới từ "of". Chỉ dùng "be comprised of" hoặc "comprise + tân ngữ".
explanation.en: In standard formal English, active "comprise" does not take the preposition "of".

vocabItem.meaningVi: các nhà dịch tễ học lỗi lạc
vocabItem.example: The panel comprised twelve eminent epidemiologists.

questions.stem: 28. Identify the error: "Scarcely (A) the autonomous lander had touched (B) down on the lunar regolith when (C) its solar arrays malfunctioned (D)."

options.text: (B) the autonomous lander had touched -> had the autonomous lander touched

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: C — "(B) the autonomous lander had touched -> had the autonomous lander touched"] "Scarcely" đứng đầu câu bắt buộc đảo trợ động từ "had" lên trước chủ ngữ ("had the autonomous lander touched").
explanation.en: Fronted "Scarcely" requires inversion of the past perfect auxiliary "had".

vocabItem.meaningVi: lớp đất đá bề mặt Mặt Trăng
vocabItem.example: The rover collected samples of lunar regolith.

questions.stem: 29. Identify the error: "The regulatory agency insisted that the biotech startup (A) discloses (B) all adverse reactions observed (C) during Phase II trials (D)."

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: D — "(B) discloses -> disclose"] Sau "insisted that + S + V_bare", động từ phải ở dạng nguyên mẫu không chia ("disclose", không phải "discloses").
explanation.en: "Insist that" triggers the mandative subjunctive (bare infinitive "disclose").

vocabItem.meaningVi: các phản ứng phụ bất lợi
vocabItem.example: Patients were monitored for adverse reactions.

questions.stem: 30. Identify the error: "A large number of (A) empirical research (B) corroborates (C) the hypothesis that chronic sleep deprivation impairs neurogenesis (D)."

options.text: (A) A large number of -> A great deal of

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: A — "(A) A large number of -> A great deal of"] "Research" là danh từ KHÔNG đếm được nên không thể đi với "A large number of"; phải sửa thành "A great deal of" hoặc "A large body of".
explanation.en: "Research" is an uncountable noun and requires "a great deal of" or "a large body of".

vocabItem.meaningVi: củng cố / xác nhận một giả thuyết khoa học
vocabItem.example: Experimental data corroborated the hypothesis.

reading.title: Section II: Reading Comprehension (26 câu hỏi)

parts.title: Part 1: Open Cloze — Cognitive Offloading & The "Google Effect" (Câu 31–40)
parts.instructions: Fill each of the numbered blanks (31–40) in the passage with ONE suitable word.
parts.passageTitle: The Epistemic Cost of Externalized Memory
parts.passage:
In contemporary cognitive science, few phenomena have provoked as much debate as the (31) {{31}} of external digital memory. Whereas human beings once relied (32) {{32}} internal hippocampal networks to encode and retrieve lived experience, the ubiquity of cloud-based search engines has fundamentally altered how we interact with knowledge. Rather (33) {{33}} memorizing facts themselves, modern learners increasingly remember merely where to locate information—a cognitive shortcut known as the "Google Effect."

While such offloading undeniably liberates working memory (34) {{34}} routine clerical tasks, neurobiologists warn that it comes at a steep epistemic (35) {{35}}. Deep conceptual creativity does not occur in a vacuum; (36) {{36}} the contrary, it depends on a dense internal web of schemas that can be cross-referenced spontaneously. (37) {{37}} students delegate this foundational synthesis to algorithmic tools, their capacity for critical discernment risks falling (38) {{38}} atrophy. Consequently, educators are called (39) {{39}} to design assessments that reward deep structural reasoning (40) {{40}} passive information retrieval.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (31): "...the (31) _______ of external digital memory."

explanation.vi: Điền "rise" / "advent" / "proliferation" (sự trỗi dậy/xuất hiện của bộ nhớ số bên ngoài).
explanation.en: The rise/advent of external digital memory.

vocabItem.meaningVi: sự ra đời / xuất hiện của
vocabItem.example: The advent of cloud computing transformed education.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (32): "...relied (32) _______ internal hippocampal networks..."

explanation.vi: Cấu trúc "rely on / upon" (dựa vào mạng lưới hồi hải mã bên trong).
explanation.en: Rely takes the preposition on or upon.

vocabItem.meaningVi: dựa vào, phụ thuộc vào
vocabItem.example: Scholars relied upon archival indices.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (33): "Rather (33) _______ memorizing facts themselves..."

explanation.vi: Cụm liên từ "Rather than + V-ing" (Thay vì tự ghi nhớ dữ kiện).
explanation.en: Rather than introduces a rejected alternative.

vocabItem.meaningVi: thay vì
vocabItem.example: Rather than memorizing dates, analyze the causes.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (34): "...liberates working memory (34) _______ routine clerical tasks..."

explanation.vi: Cấu trúc "liberate somebody/something from..." (giải phóng trí nhớ làm việc khỏi các tác vụ lặt vặt).
explanation.en: Liberate collocates with the preposition from.

vocabItem.meaningVi: giải phóng khỏi
vocabItem.example: Automation liberated workers from repetitive tasks.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (35): "...it comes at a steep epistemic (35) _______."

explanation.vi: Thành ngữ "come at a steep cost/price" (phải trả một cái giá đắt về mặt nhận thức).
explanation.en: To come at a steep cost/price means to involve a heavy sacrifice.

vocabItem.meaningVi: phải trả một cái giá rất đắt
vocabItem.example: Convenience often comes at a steep epistemic cost.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (36): "...(36) _______ the contrary, it depends on..."

explanation.vi: Cụm chuyển ý tương phản "on the contrary" (trái lại, ngược lại hoàn toàn).
explanation.en: "On the contrary" intensifies denial of the preceding negative statement.

vocabItem.meaningVi: trái lại, ngược lại hoàn toàn
vocabItem.example: Creativity is not random; on the contrary, it is disciplined.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (37): "(37) _______ students delegate this foundational synthesis..."

explanation.vi: Điền liên từ "When / Whenever / Once / If" mở đầu mệnh đề phụ chỉ điều kiện/thời gian.
explanation.en: When/Once introduces the conditional-temporal clause.

vocabItem.meaningVi: ủy thác việc tổng hợp tri thức cho
vocabItem.example: When learners delegate synthesis to AI, retention drops.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (38): "...risks falling (38) _______ atrophy."

explanation.vi: Cụm cố định "fall into atrophy / decline" (rơi vào trạng thái suy thoái / mai một).
explanation.en: "Fall into atrophy/disuse" is a fixed formal collocation.

vocabItem.meaningVi: rơi vào trạng thái thoái hóa / mai một
vocabItem.example: Unused cognitive faculties quickly fall into atrophy.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (39): "...educators are called (39) _______ to design assessments..."

explanation.rule: Phrasal Verb: "be called upon/on to do something"
explanation.vi: "Be called upon/on to V" = được kêu gọi, được yêu cầu thực hiện trọng trách.
explanation.en: To be called upon to do something means to be formally asked or required to do it.

vocabItem.meaningVi: được kêu gọi / giao trọng trách làm gì
vocabItem.example: Educators are called upon to foster critical inquiry.

questions.stem: Điền 1 từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (40): "...reward deep structural reasoning (40) _______ passive information retrieval."

explanation.rule: Preposition of Preference: "reward/prioritize A over B"
explanation.vi: Cấu trúc "reward/prioritize A over B" (đề cao tư duy cấu trúc sâu hơn là việc truy xuất thụ động).
explanation.en: "Over" expresses preference or priority between two competing approaches.

vocabItem.meaningVi: ưu tiên chiều sâu hơn tốc độ
vocabItem.example: The rubric rewards analytical depth over rote recall.

parts.title: Part 2: Guided Cloze — The Paradox of Green Gentrification (Câu 41–50)
parts.instructions: Read the passage below and decide which answer (A, B, C, or D) best fits each gap.
parts.passageTitle: Ecological Urbanism & Socioeconomic Displacement
parts.passage:
The contemporary resurgence of "ecological urbanism" has been widely lauded as a panacea for post-industrial cities. Municipal authorities across the globe have poured billions into converting derelict rail corridors into elevated botanical promenades. Yet urban sociologists warn that such initiatives frequently (41) _______ a troubling paradox known as "green gentrification." While newly landscaped districts undeniably (42) _______ ambient air quality and bolster municipal tax revenues, they simultaneously trigger speculative real-estate bubbles that price out long-standing working-class residents.

In the absence of robust rent-stabilization mandates, environmental remediation inadvertently becomes an instrument of socioeconomic exclusion. What appears (43) _______ progressive on architectural blueprints often (44) _______ vulnerable demographics to the under-resourced urban periphery. Rather than dismantling spatial inequality, poorly calibrated interventions risk (45) _______ existing class divides. Furthermore, the post-pandemic (46) _______ of remote work has disproportionately benefited affluent knowledge workers, whereas essential service personnel remain (47) _______ to grueling cross-city commutes. Reconciling ecological vitality with housing equity therefore (48) _______ a fundamental departure from market-led redevelopment. Only when municipalities anchor green infrastructure within statutory community land trusts can urban renewal avoid becoming a (49) _______ for displacement and instead foster genuine civic (50) _______.

questions.stem: Question 41: Choose the best word for blank (41) in the Guided Cloze passage:

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: A — "engender"] "Engender a paradox" = làm nảy sinh, tạo ra một nghịch lý.
explanation.en: To engender means to cause or give rise to a feeling, situation, or condition.

vocabItem.meaningVi: làm nảy sinh một nghịch lý
vocabItem.example: Green urbanism can inadvertently engender a social paradox.

questions.stem: Question 42: Choose the best word for blank (42) in the Guided Cloze passage:

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: D — "ameliorate"] "Ameliorate" = cải thiện, làm cho tốt hơn (chất lượng không khí/điều kiện sống).
explanation.en: To ameliorate means to make something bad or unsatisfactory better.

vocabItem.meaningVi: cải thiện chất lượng không khí
vocabItem.example: Urban canopies help ameliorate ambient air quality.

questions.stem: Question 43: Choose the best word for blank (43) in the Guided Cloze passage:

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: B — "ostensibly"] "Ostensibly" = bề ngoài có vẻ là (nhưng thực tế ẩn chứa mặt trái).
explanation.en: Ostensibly means apparently or purportedly, though perhaps not actually.

vocabItem.meaningVi: bề ngoài có vẻ tiến bộ
vocabItem.example: The policy was ostensibly progressive but regressive in practice.

questions.stem: Question 44: Choose the best word for blank (44) in the Guided Cloze passage:

explanation.rule: C2 Verb Structure: "relegate A to the periphery"
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: C — "relegates"] "Relegate someone to the periphery" = đẩy nhóm yếu thế ra vùng ven đô.
explanation.en: To relegate means to consign to an inferior or marginalized position.

vocabItem.meaningVi: đẩy ra vùng rìa / ven đô
vocabItem.example: Rising rents relegated low-income workers to the periphery.

questions.stem: Question 45: Choose the best word for blank (45) in the Guided Cloze passage:

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: C — "entrenching"] "Entrench existing class divides" = làm bám rễ sâu hơn sự phân hóa giai cấp.
explanation.en: To entrench means to establish a division so firmly that change is very difficult.

vocabItem.meaningVi: khoét sâu thêm sự phân hóa giai cấp
vocabItem.example: Uncalibrated subsidies risk entrenching class divides.

questions.stem: Question 46: Choose the best word for blank (46) in the Guided Cloze passage:

explanation.rule: C2 Noun: "the proliferation of remote work"
explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: D — "proliferation"] "The proliferation of remote work" = sự bùng nổ/lan rộng của hình thức làm việc từ xa.
explanation.en: Proliferation refers to rapid multiplication or widespread expansion.

vocabItem.meaningVi: sự bùng nổ lan rộng của
vocabItem.example: The proliferation of remote work reshaped urban transit.

questions.stem: Question 47: Choose the best word for blank (47) in the Guided Cloze passage:

parts.title: Part 3: Academic Reading — The Annales School & The Longue Durée (Câu 51–56)
parts.instructions: Read the following historiographical extract and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for questions 51–56.
parts.passageTitle: Beyond the "Great Man": Braudel, Microhistory, and Structural Agency
parts.passage:
Paragraph 1: For much of the twentieth century, historiography was dominated by the "Great Man" paradigm, which posited that epochal shifts in human civilization were chiefly the handiwork of charismatic statesmen, military commanders, and solitary scientific geniuses. However, the rise of the Annales school in France fundamentally subverted this event-centric orthodoxy. Pioneered by Marc Bloch and Fernand Braudel, this movement contended that political drama is merely the "crest of foam" riding upon deeper, slower currents of geographical constraint, demographic pressure, and collective mentalities—what Braudel memorably termed the longue durée.

Paragraph 2: Viewed through the prism of the longue durée, the fall of empires or the eruption of revolutions can rarely be attributed to the caprice of a single monarch. Instead, such ruptures represent the culmination of centuries-long structural stresses: soil exhaustion, shifting trade winds, monetarist inflation, or agrarian demographic ceilings. While traditional chroniclers fixated on diplomatic treaties signed in gilded palaces, structural historians turned their gaze toward parish registries, grain price ledgers, and dendrochronological ice cores.

Paragraph 3: Yet in recent decades, critics have cautioned against swinging the pendulum too far toward geographic or economic determinism. By reducing human beings to passive marionettes of climatic and material forces, extreme structuralism risks erasing moral agency and ideological contingency. Contemporary "microhistory" seeks to synthesize both scales: examining how ordinary artisans, dissidents, and marginalized communities navigated, resisted, and occasionally reshaped the macro-structural constraints of their era.

questions.stem: Question 51: What is the primary purpose of Paragraph 1?

options.text: To criticize Fernand Braudel for ignoring geographical constraints.
To argue that military commanders played no role in twentieth-century geopolitics.
To contrast traditional individual-centered history with the structural approach of the Annales school.
To chronicle the biographical rivalry between Marc Bloch and traditional diplomats.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: C — "To contrast traditional individual-centered history with the structural approach of the Annales school."] Đoạn 1 đối chiếu hệ hình "Vĩ nhân" truyền thống với trường phái Annales chú trọng cấu trúc dài hạn (longue durée).
explanation.en: Paragraph 1 contrasts the Great Man paradigm with the structural Annales school.

vocabItem.meaningVi: lật đổ một quan niệm chính thống cũ
vocabItem.example: The Annales school subverted event-centric orthodoxy.

questions.stem: Question 52: In Paragraph 1, what does Braudel’s metaphor "crest of foam" imply about political events?

options.text: They occur exclusively in maritime empires.
They are superficial manifestations of much deeper, long-term structural forces.
They are the primary driving force behind climatic and demographic change.
They are completely fabricated by biased court chroniclers.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: B — "They are superficial manifestations of much deeper, long-term structural forces."] Hình ảnh "bọt sóng trên ngọn" (crest of foam) ám chỉ các sự kiện chính trị chỉ là biểu hiện bề mặt của những dòng chảy cấu trúc sâu thẳm bên dưới.
explanation.en: Political drama is portrayed as surface-level compared to deep structural currents.

vocabItem.meaningVi: nhịp thời gian cấu trúc trường kỳ trong sử học
vocabItem.example: Braudel analyzed Mediterranean history through the longue durée.

questions.stem: Question 53: The word "caprice" in Paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to:

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: B — "impulsive whim"] "Caprice" = sự thất thường, ý thích bốc đồng nhất thời (= impulsive whim).
explanation.en: Caprice means a sudden and unaccountable change of mood or behavior; a whim.

vocabItem.meaningVi: sự thất thường / ý muốn bốc đồng của
vocabItem.example: History cannot be explained by the caprice of monarchs.

questions.stem: Question 54: Why did structural historians examine "grain price ledgers and dendrochronological ice cores" (Paragraph 2)?

options.text: To verify the exact dates when diplomatic treaties were signed in palaces.
To prove that agriculture was more profitable than maritime trade.
To reconstruct long-term material, economic, and environmental pressures on societies.
To replace historical writing with pure geological science.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: C — "To reconstruct long-term material, economic, and environmental pressures on societies."] Các sử gia cấu trúc nghiên cứu sổ giá ngũ cốc và lõi băng để tái dựng các áp lực vật chất, kinh tế và khí hậu dài hạn.
explanation.en: Such empirical sources reveal centuries-long structural stresses.

vocabItem.meaningVi: những sức ép mang tính cấu trúc
vocabItem.example: Revolutions often stem from centuries-long structural stresses.

questions.stem: Question 55: According to Paragraph 3, what is the main criticism leveled against extreme structuralism?

options.text: It relies too heavily on unreliable oral traditions.
It ignores the impact of soil exhaustion and inflation.
It places excessive emphasis on the biographies of solitary geniuses.
It risks stripping individuals of moral responsibility and historical agency.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: D — "It risks stripping individuals of moral responsibility and historical agency."] Đoạn 3 chỉ rõ: chủ nghĩa cấu trúc cực đoan biến con người thành "con rối thụ động" và xóa nhòa năng lực hành động đạo đức (moral agency).
explanation.en: Extreme structuralism risks erasing moral agency and ideological contingency.

vocabItem.meaningVi: năng lực tự chủ và chịu trách nhiệm đạo đức
vocabItem.example: Determinism risks erasing human moral agency.

questions.stem: Question 56: How does contemporary "microhistory" resolve the tension described in the passage?

options.text: By exploring how ordinary people actively negotiated and resisted large-scale structural constraints.
By proving that geography has zero influence on human culture.
By abandoning archival research in favor of computer simulations.
By returning exclusively to the study of monarchs and military generals.

explanation.vi: [Đáp án chuẩn: A — "By exploring how ordinary people actively negotiated and resisted large-scale structural constraints."] Vi sử học (microhistory) dung hòa cả hai cấp độ bằng cách khảo sát cách những con người bình thường xoay xở, phản kháng và định hình lại các ràng buộc cấu trúc vĩ mô.
explanation.en: Microhistory synthesizes both scales by studying how ordinary people navigated macro-constraints.

vocabItem.meaningVi: tính ngẫu nhiên / biến số về mặt tư tưởng
vocabItem.example: Historians must account for ideological contingency.

questions.stem: 57. Rewrite using "ILLUSION": The minister was fully aware that the austerity package would provoke fierce union resistance.
questions.answer: The minister was under no illusion that the austerity package would provoke fierce union resistance.
acceptedAnswers: The minister was under no illusion that the austerity package would provoke fierce union resistance.
under no illusion that the austerity package would provoke fierce union resistance

explanation.vi: "Be under no illusion that..." = hoàn toàn nhận thức rõ thực tế phũ phàng rằng (không hề ảo tưởng).
explanation.en: To be under no illusion means to be fully aware of the true state of affairs.

vocabItem.meaningVi: không hề ảo tưởng, nhận thức rất rõ rằng
vocabItem.example: We are under no illusion about the scale of the challenge.

questions.stem: 58. Rewrite using "SHORT": Only a comprehensive overhaul of the judicial code will restore public trust.
questions.answer: Nothing short of a comprehensive overhaul of the judicial code will restore public trust.
acceptedAnswers: Nothing short of a comprehensive overhaul of the judicial code will restore public trust.
Nothing short of a comprehensive overhaul of the judicial code

explanation.rule: C2 Emphatic Structure: "Nothing short of + Noun Phrase"
explanation.vi: "Nothing short of..." = Chỉ có một cuộc cải tổ toàn diện mới... (Không gì ít hơn điều đó có thể đủ).
explanation.en: "Nothing short of" emphasizes that only an extreme or thorough measure will suffice.

vocabItem.meaningVi: chỉ có... mới đủ / chẳng khác gì
vocabItem.example: Nothing short of systemic reform will resolve the crisis.

questions.stem: 59. Rewrite using "PAR": The apprentice’s craftsmanship was just as exquisite as that of the master guildsman.
questions.answer: The apprentice’s craftsmanship was on a par with that of the master guildsman.
acceptedAnswers: The apprentice’s craftsmanship was on a par with that of the master guildsman.
on a par with that of the master guildsman

explanation.rule: C2 Idiom: "be on a par with"
explanation.vi: "Be on a par with somebody/something" = ngang tầm, sánh ngang về chất lượng/đẳng cấp với.
explanation.en: To be on a par with means to be equal in importance or quality to.

vocabItem.meaningVi: ngang tầm / sánh ngang với
vocabItem.example: Local research output is now on a par with international benchmarks.

questions.stem: 60. Rewrite using "BRUNT": Small coastal communities suffered the worst impact of the supply-chain disruption.
questions.answer: Small coastal communities bore the brunt of the supply-chain disruption.
acceptedAnswers: Small coastal communities bore the brunt of the supply-chain disruption.
bore the brunt of the supply-chain disruption

explanation.vi: "Bear the brunt of something" = gánh chịu mũi nhọn / phần thiệt hại nặng nề nhất của một biến cố.
explanation.en: To bear the brunt of something is to suffer the worst part of an unpleasant or problematic situation.

vocabItem.meaningVi: gánh chịu hậu quả nặng nề nhất của
vocabItem.example: Frontline workers bore the brunt of the pandemic.
