vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: Adjectives of urgency trigger the bare infinitive subjunctive.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: trải qua kiểm thử chịu tải khắc nghiệt
vocab_vault.example: Banks must undergo rigorous stress-testing.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: Fronted "So + adjective" triggers subject-verb inversion.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: chủ nghĩa thân hữu / nâng đỡ trong bộ máy
vocab_vault.example: The reform aimed to dismantle institutional patronage.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: Fronted adjective + as/though expresses concession.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: ngược với trực giác thông thường
vocab_vault.example: Counterintuitive as it may seem, higher road capacity can increase congestion.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: Hardly/Scarcely... when requires past perfect inversion in the first clause.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: một tràng câu hỏi dồn dập
vocab_vault.example: The minister faced a barrage of incisive questions.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: Negative restrictive phrases at the beginning of a clause trigger inversion.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: lách qua / vượt trái phép các giao thức
vocab_vault.example: No employee is allowed to circumvent security protocols.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: "Were + subject + to-infinitive" forms an inverted second conditional.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: ngừng trệ hoàn toàn
vocab_vault.example: Industrial output ground to a halt during the crisis.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: Fronted "Not until" requires subject-auxiliary inversion in the main clause.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: mưu kế/thủ đoạn ngầm địa chính trị
vocab_vault.example: The archives exposed decades of geopolitical subterfuge.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: The process of recording and transmitting the readings of an instrument automatically. | Collocations: collect telemetry, transmit telemetry, disclose raw telemetry
vocab_vault.definition_vi: dữ liệu đo lường và truyền dẫn từ xa (trong y sinh, hàng không, thuật toán) (⚠️ Bẫy HSGQG/DHBB: "Telemetry" là danh từ KHÔNG đếm được (Uncountable Noun) — không dùng "a telemetry" hay "telemetries"; khi muốn đếm hãy dùng "telemetry data" hoặc "streams of telemetry".)
vocab_vault.example: collect telemetry
vocab_vault.source_exam: Ozdic Double-Click Collocation Dictionary

vocab_vault.definition_en: High-register adjective used in formal academic discourse and analytical prose. | Collocations: clinical systemic disparities, clinical institutional frameworks
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Từ học thuật C1/C2 trong ngữ cảnh bài đọc ("clinical") — thường xuất hiện trong phần Reading & Lexico-Grammar của đề HSGQG và Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ. (⚠️ Lưu ý C1/C2 (HSGQG/DHBB): Khi gặp "clinical" trong bài Word Formation hoặc Open Cloze, hãy kiểm tra kỹ từ loại (adjective), tiền tố phủ định (un-/in-/ir-/dis-) và giới từ đi kèm ngay sau từ này trong câu.)
vocab_vault.example: clinical systemic disparities
vocab_vault.source_exam: Ozdic Double-Click Collocation Dictionary

vocab_vault.definition_en: "An overly idealized/idealistic view" describes an unrealistically romanticized perception.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: cái nhìn được lý tưởng hóa quá mức
vocab_vault.example: The memoir offers an idealized portrait of rural life.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Đề Chọn Đội Tuyển HSGQG 2025 – THPT Chuyên Phan Bội Châu (Nghệ An)

vocab_vault.definition_en: "A source of contention" is an idiomatic collocation referring to a topic of heated disagreement.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: nguồn cơn gây tranh cãi, bất đồng
vocab_vault.example: Border tariffs remain a major source of contention.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Đề Chọn Đội Tuyển HSGQG 2025 – THPT Chuyên Phan Bội Châu (Nghệ An)

vocab_vault.definition_en: "Commensurate with" means corresponding in size or degree; in proportion.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: tương xứng với, xứng tầm với
vocab_vault.example: Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Đề Chọn Đội Tuyển HSGQG 2025 – THPT Chuyên Phan Bội Châu (Nghệ An)

vocab_vault.definition_en: "Irrefutable proof" means evidence that is impossible to deny or disprove.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: không thể bác bỏ, không thể chối cãi
vocab_vault.example: They presented irrefutable evidence to the tribunal.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Đề Chọn Đội Tuyển HSGQG 2025 – THPT Chuyên Phan Bội Châu (Nghệ An)

vocab_vault.definition_en: "Authoritarian rule" denotes strict obedience to authority at the expense of personal freedom.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: độc đoán, chuyên quyền (khác với authoritative: có uy tín, chuẩn xác)
vocab_vault.example: The regime drifted toward authoritarian rule.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Đề Chọn Đội Tuyển HSGQG 2025 – THPT Chuyên Phan Bội Châu (Nghệ An)

vocab_vault.definition_en: "Smoke and mirrors" refers to the obscuring or embellishing of the truth of a situation with misleading or irrelevant information.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: trò tung hỏa mù, sự hào nhoáng đánh lừa
vocab_vault.example: Critics dismissed the budget plan as mere smoke and mirrors.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Đề Chọn Đội Tuyển HSGQG 2025 – THPT Chuyên Phan Bội Châu (Nghệ An)

vocab_vault.definition_en: To broker an agreement or compromise means to arrange or negotiate it as an intermediary.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: làm trung gian dàn xếp một thỏa hiệp
vocab_vault.example: United Nations envoys worked overnight to broker a compromise.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Đề Chọn Đội Tuyển HSGQG 2025 – THPT Chuyên Phan Bội Châu (Nghệ An)

vocab_vault.definition_en: "Notwithstanding" is a formal preposition meaning "in spite of" or "despite".
vocab_vault.definition_vi: những điểm bắt bẻ nhỏ về phương pháp luận
vocab_vault.example: Notwithstanding minor quibbles, the study is groundbreaking.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Đề Thi Olympic Trại Hè Hùng Vương Lần Thứ XIX – THPT Chuyên Hùng Vương (Phú Thọ)

vocab_vault.definition_en: "Disinformation" refers to false information which is intended to mislead, especially propaganda issued by an organization.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: chiến dịch tung tin giả có chủ đích thao túng
vocab_vault.example: Countering coordinated disinformation campaigns requires media literacy.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: "Avant-garde" describes new and experimental ideas and methods in art, music, or literature.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: tiên phong, thử nghiệm táo bạo (trong nghệ thuật)
vocab_vault.example: She is a pioneer of avant-garde cinema.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: To exacerbate means to make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: làm trầm trọng thêm, làm xấu đi
vocab_vault.example: Drought conditions exacerbated the food shortage.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: "An overly idealized/idealistic view" describes an unrealistically romanticized perception.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: cái nhìn được lý tưởng hóa quá mức
vocab_vault.example: The memoir offers an idealized portrait of rural life.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_vi: nguồn cơn gây tranh cãi, bất đồng
vocab_vault.example: Border tariffs remain a major source of contention.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_vi: tương xứng với, xứng tầm với
vocab_vault.example: Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_vi: không thể bác bỏ, không thể chối cãi
vocab_vault.example: They presented irrefutable evidence to the tribunal.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: "Authoritarian rule" denotes strict obedience to authority at the expense of personal freedom.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: độc đoán, chuyên quyền (khác với authoritative: có uy tín, chuẩn xác)
vocab_vault.example: The regime drifted toward authoritarian rule.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: Modifying the compound adjective "one-sided" requires the negative adverb "unabashedly" (without embarrassment or shame).
vocab_vault.definition_vi: một cách thẳng thừng, không chút e dè hay giấu giếm
vocab_vault.example: The novel is unabashedly sentimental.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: The definite article "The" followed by "of" requires the abstract noun "ubiquity".
vocab_vault.definition_vi: sự hiện diện ở khắp mọi nơi, tính phổ biến toàn diện
vocab_vault.example: The ubiquity of smartphones has transformed social interaction.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: To pull the plug on something means to prevent it from continuing or happening, especially by stopping financial support.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: ngừng cấp vốn, chấm dứt hoàn toàn một dự án
vocab_vault.example: The studio pulled the plug on the project after budget overruns.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: EQUIVOCATE -> UNEQUIVOCAL (leaving no doubt; unambiguous).
vocab_vault.definition_vi: sự lên án dứt khoát, không mập mờ
vocab_vault.example: The council issued an unequivocal condemnation of the attack.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: Inverted third-second mixed conditional linking a past counterfactual condition to an ongoing present result.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: lắng nghe và lưu tâm đến lời cảnh báo
vocab_vault.example: Policymakers failed to heed the early warnings.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: "Devoid of" means entirely lacking or free from.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: hoàn toàn trống rỗng, thiếu vắng
vocab_vault.example: The prose was technically accurate but devoid of warmth.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: "Notwithstanding" is a formal preposition meaning "in spite of" or "despite".
vocab_vault.definition_vi: những điểm bắt bẻ nhỏ về phương pháp luận
vocab_vault.example: Notwithstanding minor quibbles, the study is groundbreaking.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: When "Only after + clause" precedes the main clause, subject-auxiliary inversion occurs in the main clause.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: bị phơi bày, được phát hiện ra ánh sáng
vocab_vault.example: New archival evidence has recently come to light.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: "Smoke and mirrors" refers to the obscuring or embellishing of the truth with misleading information.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: trò hào nhoáng đánh lừa thị giác, sự che mắt
vocab_vault.example: The company’s financial recovery was nothing more than smoke and mirrors.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: Initial "Little" with verbs of cognition (know, suspect, realize, think) triggers auxiliary inversion.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: tạo nên nền tảng cốt lõi của
vocab_vault.example: Empirical falsifiability forms the cornerstone of scientific inquiry.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: To broker an agreement or compromise means to arrange or negotiate it as an intermediary.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: làm trung gian dàn xếp một thỏa hiệp
vocab_vault.example: United Nations envoys worked overnight to broker a compromise.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: "Given" functions as a preposition meaning "taking into account" before a noun phrase.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: có khả năng chịu lỗi / tự sửa lỗi hệ thống
vocab_vault.example: Fault-tolerant architecture is indispensable in aerospace computing.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: "Assuage anxieties" is a high-register collocation meaning to make unpleasant feelings less intense.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: xoa dịu, làm vơi đi nỗi lo ngại
vocab_vault.example: The statement failed to assuage investor anxieties.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: Verbs of demand/insistence trigger the mandative subjunctive (bare infinitive) in formal prose.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: dữ liệu đo lường thử nghiệm lâm sàng
vocab_vault.example: The agency demanded that the firm disclose all clinical telemetry.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: To be left high and dry means to be stranded in a difficult situation without help or resources.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: bỏ mặc ai trong tình thế khó khăn, bơ vơ
vocab_vault.example: The sudden withdrawal of funding left the research team high and dry.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: Equivocation means the use of ambiguous language to conceal the truth or avoid committing oneself.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: sự nói nước đôi, lập lờ đánh tráo khái niệm
vocab_vault.example: He responded with characteristic equivocation during the inquiry.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: After "Not until + subordinate clause", the main clause requires auxiliary inversion (did + subject + bare infinitive).
vocab_vault.definition_vi: thấu hiểu/đo lường hết mức độ của
vocab_vault.example: Few could fathom the extent of the structural reforms.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kho Đề Thi HSGQG & Duyên Hải Bắc Bộ

vocab_vault.definition_en: A striking difference in the direction or trend of data series over time.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: sự phân hóa rõ rệt về quỹ đạo phát triển (dùng cho Chart Part 2)
vocab_vault.example: The chart reveals a marked divergence in trajectories between active recall cohorts and passive readers.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Writing Studio (WRITING_SUMMARY)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Replaces: big difference in how numbers changed

vocab_vault.definition_en: To navigate a delicate balance between two conflicting demands.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: giữ thế cân bằng mong manh giữa hai thái cực
vocab_vault.example: Policymakers must walk a tightrope between fostering technological innovation and safeguarding civic autonomy.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Writing Studio (WRITING_SUMMARY)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Replaces: balance carefully between two things

vocab_vault.term: cast doubt upon the tenability of
vocab_vault.definition_en: To question whether a claim or policy can be maintained or defended.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: đặt dấu hỏi nghi ngờ về tính bền vững/hợp lý của
vocab_vault.example: Recent empirical findings cast doubt upon the tenability of purely punitive regulations.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Writing Studio (WRITING_SUMMARY)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Replaces: make people question if it works

vocab_vault.definition_en: To worsen entrenched inequalities within a system.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: làm trầm trọng thêm sự bất bình đẳng mang tính hệ thống
vocab_vault.example: Unequal access to AI tools may well exacerbate structural disparities in education.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Writing Studio (WRITING_SUMMARY)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Replaces: make unfairness worse

vocab_vault.definition_en: To deserve or require careful, critical examination.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: đòi hỏi sự thẩm định / xem xét kỹ lưỡng
vocab_vault.example: The long-term cognitive ramifications of hyper-connectivity warrant rigorous scrutiny.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Writing Studio (WRITING_SUMMARY)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Replaces: need to be looked at carefully

vocab_vault.definition_en: Rapid, unchecked growth or spread of a phenomenon.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: sự bùng nổ / gia tăng không kiểm soát
vocab_vault.example: The unbridled proliferation of algorithmic feeds has fundamentally reshaped public discourse.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Writing Studio (WRITING_SUMMARY)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Replaces: growing very fast / spreading everywhere

vocab_vault.definition_vi: làm trầm trọng thêm sự bất bình đẳng mang tính hệ thống
vocab_vault.example: Unequal access to AI tools may well exacerbate structural disparities in education.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Writing Studio (WRITING_SUMMARY)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Replaces: make unfairness worse

vocab_vault.definition_en: To deserve or require careful, critical examination.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: đòi hỏi sự thẩm định / xem xét kỹ lưỡng
vocab_vault.example: The long-term cognitive ramifications of hyper-connectivity warrant rigorous scrutiny.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Writing Studio (WRITING_SUMMARY)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Replaces: need to be looked at carefully

vocab_vault.definition_en: Rapid, unchecked growth or spread of a phenomenon.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: sự bùng nổ / gia tăng không kiểm soát
vocab_vault.example: The unbridled proliferation of algorithmic feeds has fundamentally reshaped public discourse.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Writing Studio (WRITING_SUMMARY)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Replaces: growing very fast / spreading everywhere

vocab_vault.definition_en: A striking difference in the direction or trend of data series over time.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: sự phân hóa rõ rệt về quỹ đạo phát triển (dùng cho Chart Part 2)
vocab_vault.example: The chart reveals a marked divergence in trajectories between active recall cohorts and passive readers.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Writing Studio (WRITING_SUMMARY)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Replaces: big difference in how numbers changed

vocab_vault.definition_en: To navigate a delicate balance between two conflicting demands.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: giữ thế cân bằng mong manh giữa hai thái cực
vocab_vault.example: Policymakers must walk a tightrope between fostering technological innovation and safeguarding civic autonomy.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Writing Studio (WRITING_SUMMARY)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Replaces: balance carefully between two things

vocab_vault.term: cast doubt upon the tenability of
vocab_vault.definition_en: To question whether a claim or policy can be maintained or defended.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: đặt dấu hỏi nghi ngờ về tính bền vững/hợp lý của
vocab_vault.example: Recent empirical findings cast doubt upon the tenability of purely punitive regulations.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Writing Studio (WRITING_SUMMARY)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Replaces: make people question if it works

vocab_vault.definition_en: To worsen entrenched inequalities within a system.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: làm trầm trọng thêm sự bất bình đẳng mang tính hệ thống
vocab_vault.example: Unequal access to AI tools may well exacerbate structural disparities in education.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Writing Studio (WRITING_SUMMARY)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Replaces: make unfairness worse

vocab_vault.definition_en: To deserve or require careful, critical examination.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: đòi hỏi sự thẩm định / xem xét kỹ lưỡng
vocab_vault.example: The long-term cognitive ramifications of hyper-connectivity warrant rigorous scrutiny.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Writing Studio (WRITING_SUMMARY)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Replaces: need to be looked at carefully

vocab_vault.definition_en: Rapid, unchecked growth or spread of a phenomenon.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: sự bùng nổ / gia tăng không kiểm soát
vocab_vault.example: The unbridled proliferation of algorithmic feeds has fundamentally reshaped public discourse.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Writing Studio (WRITING_SUMMARY)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Replaces: growing very fast / spreading everywhere

vocab_vault.definition_en: To disagree strongly or argue with someone about something
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Ph?n d?i / B?t d?ng quan di?m m?nh m? v?i
vocab_vault.example: Several leading epistemologists took issue with the premise of the panel.
vocab_vault.source_exam: HSGQG 2025 - Question #8

vocab_vault.term: Only after the cathedral was posthumously completed did people begin to appreciate the architect’s radical vision. (< DID)
vocab_vault.definition_en: Fronting "Only after [subordinate clause]" triggers subject-auxiliary inversion in the main clause ("did people begin...").
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Khi đưa cụm trạng ngữ chỉ thời gian bắt đầu bằng "Only after + mệnh đề phụ" lên đầu câu, mệnh đề chính bắt buộc phải đảo ngữ: "did people begin to appreciate...". Lưu ý không đảo ngữ ở mệnh đề phụ ngay sau "Only after"!
vocab_vault.example: People only began to appreciate the architect’s radical vision after the cathedral was posthumously completed. (DID)
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Negative/Restrictive Adverbial Inversion ("Only after + clause + did + S + V_inf")

vocab_vault.term: The diplomat’s refusal to budge an inch during the summit ultimately caused the treaty negotiations to collapse. (< BUDGE)
vocab_vault.definition_en: To refuse to change one’s position, decision, or attitude even slightly.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Kiên quyết không nhượng bộ dù chỉ một phân.
vocab_vault.example: Despite hours of intense bargaining, management would not budge an inch on wages.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Nominalization + Idiom "refuse to budge (an inch)"

vocab_vault.term: For instance, administrative roles that once required only a high school diploma now routinely demand a master’s degree as an initial screening filter.
vocab_vault.definition_en: Option A provides a concrete illustration ("For instance...") of employers raising baseline qualification thresholds for unchanged job roles, bridging seamlessly to the "Consequently..." sentence after the gap.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Câu trước [Gap 24] nói về việc nhà tuyển dụng liên tục nâng chuẩn bằng cấp tối thiểu cho những công việc mà yêu cầu nhận thức thực tế không đổi. Câu A ("For instance, administrative roles that once required only a high school diploma now routinely demand a master’s degree...") đưa ra ví dụ cụ thể hoàn hảo và nối mạch trực tiếp với câu "Consequently, individuals without elite credentials are excluded...".
vocab_vault.example: Which of the following sentences best fits into [Gap 24] in Paragraph C?
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Gapped Text Cohesion & Exemplification

vocab_vault.term: Because they believe their high status is fully deserved due to their personal talent and hard work.
vocab_vault.definition_en: "attribute their privilege entirely to their own innate virtue and industriousness" directly corresponds to Option A.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Câu cuối Đoạn A giải thích: giới tinh hoa trong chế độ nhân tài quy đặc quyền của họ hoàn toàn cho phẩm chất bẩm sinh và sự chăm chỉ của bản thân ("attribute their privilege entirely to their own innate virtue and industriousness"), khiến họ thờ ơ về mặt đạo đức trước hoàn cảnh của tầng lớp lao động.
vocab_vault.example: According to Paragraph A, why is a meritocratic elite potentially more unsympathetic toward disadvantaged citizens than a hereditary aristocracy?
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Reading Inference & Causal Analysis

vocab_vault.definition_en: Paragraph B states that exams "far from leveling the playing field" have instead triggered an arms race that "closely tracks household wealth".
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Đoạn B chỉ ra rằng các kỳ thi chuẩn hóa "far from leveling the playing field" (còn lâu mới tạo ra sân chơi bình đẳng), trái lại còn thúc đẩy cuộc chạy đua học thêm gắn chặt với tài sản gia đình ("closely tracks household wealth"). Vì vậy câu này là FALSE.
vocab_vault.example: OECD statistics show that high-stakes testing has completely eliminated the influence of family wealth on university admissions.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN — Negation & Idiomatic Contrast ("far from leveling the playing field")

vocab_vault.definition_en: Paragraph A explicitly states he intended the term "not as a utopian blueprint, but as a dystopian warning," directly contradicting the claim that he advocated for it.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Đoạn A khẳng định rõ: Michael Young đặt ra từ "meritocracy" trong một tiểu luận châm biếm và ông "intended it not as a utopian blueprint, but as a dystopian warning" (không phải hình mẫu lý tưởng mà là một lời cảnh báo phản địa đàng). Do đó nhận định ông ủng hộ xã hội đó là FALSE.
vocab_vault.example: Michael Young invented the word "meritocracy" to advocate for a fairer society based on intelligence testing.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN — Direct Contradiction Detection

vocab_vault.definition_en: Post-positive adjective phrase "responsible for" governing the noun phrase "autobiographical memory consolidation".
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Tính từ "responsible" đi với giới từ "for" (chịu trách nhiệm / đảm nhận chức năng gì).
vocab_vault.example: Blank (20): "...the neural networks responsible for autobiographical memory..."
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Adjective + Preposition Collocation ("responsible for")

vocab_vault.definition_en: It is not surprising that (used to emphasize a logical consequence).
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Chẳng trách sao, không có gì lạ khi...
vocab_vault.example: With housing costs soaring, little wonder young graduates are delaying marriage.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Elliptical Idiomatic Expression ("Little wonder [that] + clause")

vocab_vault.definition_en: Almost completely; virtually (e.g., all but impossible, all but eradicated).
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Gần như hoàn toàn, hầu như.
vocab_vault.example: Traditional letter-writing has all but disappeared in the digital era.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: C2 Idiomatic Adverbial ("all but" = almost completely)

vocab_vault.definition_en: Pairs with "neither" to form the correlative conjunction "neither ... nor ...".
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Cấu trúc tương quan "neither A nor B" (không phải A mà cũng chẳng phải B). Do có "neither" phía trước nên chỗ trống số 17 bắt buộc là "nor".
vocab_vault.example: Blank (17): "...solitude was neither a luxury nor an eccentricity..."
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Correlative Conjunction ("neither ... nor ...")

vocab_vault.definition_en: Not influenced by considerations of personal advantage; impartial and objective.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Vô tư, khách quan, không vụ lợi (khác với uninterested = không quan tâm).
vocab_vault.example: A judge must remain a disinterested arbiter of the law.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Confusable Derivative: "disinterested" (impartial) vs. "uninterested" (bored)

vocab_vault.definition_en: To simplify something to such an extent that a distorted impression is given.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Đơn giản hóa quá mức (dẫn đến sai lệch bản chất).
vocab_vault.example: Pundits often oversimplify macroeconomic trends for television audiences.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Prefix "over-" + Verbal Suffix "-ify"

vocab_vault.definition_en: To worsen social and economic disparities within a population.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Làm trầm trọng thêm sự bất bình đẳng kinh tế - xã hội.
vocab_vault.example: Inflationary shocks tend to exacerbate socioeconomic inequalities.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Negative Abstract Noun Derivation ("in- + equality")

vocab_vault.definition_en: Showing an unwillingness to make concessions to others, especially by changing one's ways or opinions.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Không khoan nhượng, kiên quyết, triệt để.
vocab_vault.example: She is renowned for her uncompromising integrity.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Negative Participial Adjective ("un- + V-ing")

vocab_vault.definition_en: To understand a difficult or enigmatic problem after much thought.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Thấu hiểu, nắm bắt được (vấn đề sâu xa, hóc búa).
vocab_vault.example: Even veteran diplomats struggled to fathom the premier’s sudden policy reversal.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: C1/C2 Verbs of Comprehension

vocab_vault.definition_en: To secretly or skilfully organize a complex event, plot, or political campaign.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Dàn dựng, giật dây, tổ chức tinh vi (một chiến dịch, cuộc biểu tình).
vocab_vault.example: The smear campaign was carefully orchestrated by rival operatives.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Political & Journalistic Register ("orchestrate a campaign/protest/coup")

vocab_vault.definition_en: To take the blame or responsibility alone, especially for misconduct shared by others.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Giơ đầu chịu báng, chịu tội thay cho người khác.
vocab_vault.example: Why should lower-level managers carry the can for a flawed boardroom strategy?
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: C2 Idioms of Blame & Responsibility

vocab_vault.definition_en: Support or approval that is understood or implied without being directly stated.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Sự ủng hộ / chấp thuận ngầm.
vocab_vault.example: By remaining silent during the vote, the committee gave tacit approval to the merger.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Academic Collocation ("tacit support / approval / agreement")

vocab_vault.definition_en: To ruin, wreck, or destroy a project, negotiation, or reputation completely.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Làm phá sản, đánh sập hoàn toàn (kế hoạch, đàm phán, danh tiếng).
vocab_vault.example: Fresh allegations of fraud torpedoed his chances-of re-election.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Metaphorical C2 Verbs & Collocations

vocab_vault.term: Had it not been for the fact
vocab_vault.definition_en: Inverted third conditional structure used when followed by a finite clause instead of a noun phrase.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Nếu không nhờ vào thực tế là... (Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 3 đi với mệnh đề).
vocab_vault.example: Had it not been for the fact that she spoke fluent Mandarin, the negotiation would have stalled.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Type 3 Conditional Inversion with Clause ("that + S + V")

vocab_vault.term: Outside sources have been preemptively delegitimized, turning criticism into proof of a conspiracy.
vocab_vault.definition_en: Matches "preemptively inoculated against outside sources" and "framed as corroboration of a grand conspiracy".
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Trong bài nghe, thành viên trong "echo chamber" đã bị "tiêm phòng trước" (preemptively inoculated) để nghi ngờ nguồn tin bên ngoài, và mọi phản biện đều bị coi là bằng chứng củng cố (corroboration) cho thuyết âm mưu.
vocab_vault.example: Why does counter-evidence fail to persuade members of an "echo chamber"?
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Paraphrase of Complex Argumentation

vocab_vault.term: Through unintentional omission resulting from social similarity and algorithmic filtering.
vocab_vault.definition_en: Leaving out perspectives or facts unintentionally rather than by active rejection.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Sự loại trừ do bỏ sót (vô tình không tiếp cận chứ không phải chủ đích bài xích).
vocab_vault.example: Epistemic bubbles arise from exclusion by omission.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Conceptual Contrast in C2 Academic Listening

vocab_vault.definition_en: Lack of coherent visual landmarks causes inhabitants to experience "subliminal spatial anxiety".
vocab_vault.definition_vi: "lacks coherent visual landmarks" = "absence of clear visual landmarks"; "inhabitants" = "city dwellers". Hiện tượng tâm lý gây ra là "subliminal spatial anxiety".
vocab_vault.example: An absence of clear visual landmarks triggers subliminal spatial anxiety among city dwellers.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Cause-Effect Tracking in Academic Listening

vocab_vault.definition_en: To alleviate or lessen mental exhaustion caused by prolonged intellectual effort.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Làm giảm sự mệt mỏi về nhận thức/trí óc.
vocab_vault.example: Short intervals in green spaces help mitigate cognitive fatigue.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Lexical Substitution (mitigates cognitive fatigue = reduces mental exhaustion)

vocab_vault.definition_en: The speaker explicitly states that articulated storefronts and fractal complexity foster "restorative fascination".
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Động từ "foster" trong bài nghe tương ứng với "induce a state of". Thuật ngữ chuyên ngành được nhắc đến ngay sau "term" là "restorative fascination".
vocab_vault.example: Streets designed with fractal complexity and varied storefronts induce a state of restorative fascination.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Paraphrase Recognition (foster = induce a state of)

vocab_vault.definition_en: A massive, uniform, and featureless building exterior.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Mặt tiền tòa nhà khổng lồ, đơn điệu, nguyên khối.
vocab_vault.example: Monolithic glass facades often alienate pedestrians at street level.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Chọn Học sinh Giỏi Quốc gia THPT (HSGQG - NEC 2025 Official Format)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Listening Note Completion — Exact Noun Phrase Extraction (Max 3 Words)

vocab_vault.definition_en: C1/C2 morphological derivative of NULL: "nullified".
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Từ phái sinh C1/C2 của NULL: "nullified".
vocab_vault.example: The treaty was rendered nullified by the sudden outbreak of border skirmishes. (NULL)
vocab_vault.source_exam: Đề thi Olympic Truyền thống 30/4 Năm 2024 — THPT Chuyên Thoại Ngọc Hầu An Giang

vocab_vault.definition_en: C1/C2 morphological derivative of WAVERING: "unwavering".
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Từ phái sinh C1/C2 của WAVERING: "unwavering".
vocab_vault.example: Her unwavering commitment to archival accuracy earned her the prestigious historiography medal. (WAVERING)
vocab_vault.source_exam: Đề thi Olympic Truyền thống 30/4 Năm 2024 — THPT Chuyên Thoại Ngọc Hầu An Giang

vocab_vault.definition_en: "To wrong-foot someone" means to catch them off guard or place them in an awkward, defensive position.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Động từ "wrong-foot (sb)" = làm đối phương bất ngờ, trở tay không kịp và rơi vào thế bị động lúng túng.
vocab_vault.example: The defense attorney's cross-examination completely wrong-footed the prosecution's star witness, exposing glaring contradictions.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Đề thi Olympic Truyền thống 30/4 Năm 2024 — THPT Chuyên Thoại Ngọc Hầu An Giang

vocab_vault.definition_en: "On a shoestring" means using very little money or operating on an extremely tight budget.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Thành ngữ "on a shoestring (budget)" = sống hoặc vận hành công việc với ngân sách vô cùng eo hẹp, ít ỏi.
vocab_vault.example: Having squandered his inheritance on reckless ventures, the young heir was reduced to living on a shoestring.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Đề thi Olympic Truyền thống 30/4 Năm 2024 — THPT Chuyên Thoại Ngọc Hầu An Giang

vocab_vault.definition_en: C1/C2 morphological derivative of PASSION: "dispassionate".
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Từ phái sinh C1/C2 của PASSION: "dispassionate".
vocab_vault.example: Critics praised the biographer for her dispassionate impartiality in chronicling the controversial statesman. (PASSION)
vocab_vault.source_exam: Kỳ thi Olympic Trại hè Hùng Vương 2024 — THPT Chuyên Bắc Giang

vocab_vault.definition_en: C1/C2 morphological derivative of NIHIL: "nihilism".

vocab_vault.definition_en: Option A ("would have") forms a grammatically sound inverted conditional structure.

vocab_vault.definition_en: Endorsement or agreement that is understood or implied without being stated aloud.

vocab_vault.definition_en: To be so satisfied with past achievements that one stops putting in effort.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Ngủ quên trên chiến thắng, tự mãn với hào quang quá khứ.

vocab_vault.definition_en: To use ambiguous or evasive language so as to conceal the truth or avoid committing oneself.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Nói nước đôi, vòng vo lấp liếm để né tránh sự thật.
vocab_vault.example: Questioned about the missing endowment funds, the treasurer began to equivocate.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Olympic 30/4 2024
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Noun: equivocation; Adjective: equivocal.

vocab_vault.definition_en: To refuse stubbornly to make any concession or change one’s stance.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Kiên quyết không nhượng bộ dù chỉ một phân.
vocab_vault.example: The diplomat’s refusal to budge an inch caused the summit to collapse.
vocab_vault.source_exam: HSGQG 2025 — Sentence Transformation
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Synonyms: stand/hold one’s ground, dig one’s heels in.

vocab_vault.term: put/set the cat among the pigeons
vocab_vault.definition_en: To say or do something that causes sudden alarm, controversy, or upheaval.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Làm xôn xao, gây chấn động và náo loạn dư luận.
vocab_vault.example: The opposition leader’s speech set the cat among the pigeons in parliament.
vocab_vault.source_exam: Trại hè Hùng Vương 2024
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Both "put" and "set" are accepted verbs.

vocab_vault.definition_en: Disinterested = impartial, objective, having no personal stake; Uninterested = bored, indifferent.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Disinterested = vô tư, khách quan, không vụ lợi; Uninterested = thờ ơ, không quan tâm.
vocab_vault.example: The alibi was corroborated by three disinterested bystanders.
vocab_vault.source_exam: HSGQG 2025 — Word Formation
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Root word: INTEREST. High-frequency trap in HSGQG and Olympic 30/4.

vocab_vault.definition_en: To be too extraordinary, shocking, or wonderful to be described adequately or believed.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Không lời nào tả xiết / Vượt quá sức tưởng tượng.
vocab_vault.example: The sheer virtuosity of the young pianist’s performance beggared description.
vocab_vault.source_exam: DHBB 2024 — Sentence Transformation
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Frequently tested in Sentence Transformation with keyword BEGGAR / BEGGARED.

vocab_vault.definition_en: To sound insincere, unconvincing, or devoid of genuine commitment.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Nghe sáo rỗng, giả tạo, thiếu chân thành (trái nghĩa: ring true).
vocab_vault.example: The CEO’s apology rang hollow after his multi-million-dollar bonus was leaked.
vocab_vault.source_exam: DHBB 2024 — Khối 11
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Antonym: ring true (nghe có vẻ thật/đáng tin).

vocab_vault.definition_en: To take the blame or responsibility alone, especially for mistakes committed by others.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Đứng mũi chịu sào, giơ đầu chịu báng thay cho người khác.
vocab_vault.example: Junior compliance officers were left to carry the can for executive negligence.
vocab_vault.source_exam: HSGQG 2025 (NEC)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Often used with verbs like "leave sb to carry the can" or "make sb carry the can".

vocab_vault.term: Had it not been for the fact that...
vocab_vault.definition_en: Inverted third conditional structure used when followed by a full finite clause rather than a noun phrase.
vocab_vault.definition_vi: Nếu không nhờ vào thực tế là... (Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 3 đi với mệnh đề hoàn chỉnh).
vocab_vault.example: Had it not been for the fact that the central bank intervened, the currency would have collapsed.
vocab_vault.source_exam: HSGQG 2025 (NEC)
vocab_vault.grammar_note: Compare with "But for + Noun Phrase" and "Were it not for + Noun Phrase".

writing_submissions.prompt_title: Read the following extract on "Algorithmic Epistemology and the Erosion of Deep Reading" and use your own words to summarize it. Your summar
writing_submissions.content: Nowadays, the proliferation of algorithmic curation across digital ecosystems has changed how people read every day. Instead of deep reading, students spend too much time on fragmented information foraging on social media. Even though personalized feeds give people access to global knowledge, their underlying reinforcement schedules prioritize instantaneous affective arousal rather than deep thinking. Because of this problem, readers suffer from skimming-induced superficiality and cannot understand complex arguments. Moreover, recommendation engines systematically filter out dissonant viewpoints, which creates echo chambers and hurts public discussion. Therefore, schools need to teach slow-reading pedagogy so that technological convenience will not destroy analytical autonomy.

evaluation.modelEssayC1Plus:
In an era defined by rapid technological acceleration, the question of whether algorithmic systems enhance or erode human intellectual autonomy has sparked intense debate. While digital platforms undeniably democratize access to global knowledge, I contend that their uncritical adoption poses profound risks to deep analytical cognition unless counterbalanced by rigorous educational guardrails.

On the one hand, proponents rightly observe that modern information ecosystems lower barriers to specialized learning. Students in remote provinces can now access archive repositories, corpus linguistics tools, and real-time diagnostic feedback that were previously restricted to elite metropolitan institutions. In this respect, technology acts as an equalizer of educational opportunity.

On the other hand, the commercial architecture of attention economies incentivizes cognitive superficiality. Constant notifications and fragmented media streams undermine the sustained concentration required for complex synthesis. More concerningly, over-reliance on automated outputs can atrophy independent problem-solving skills.

In conclusion, technology should serve as a cognitive scaffold rather than a substitute for critical inquiry. By integrating deliberate digital literacy into curricula, society can harness technological efficiency while preserving intellectual depth.
evaluation.modelEssayC2NationalPrize:
Scarcely a decade has elapsed since algorithmic platforms were heralded as the ultimate catalyst for universal enlightenment; yet their pervasive integration into contemporary life has ignited a polarized discourse regarding the fate of human epistemic agency. Notwithstanding the unprecedented democratization of archival knowledge facilitated by digital infrastructure, I am firmly of the conviction that unbridled algorithmic mediation threatens to atrophy autonomous critical faculties unless tempered by stringent pedagogical guardrails.

Granted, one cannot dismiss the transformative potential of computational tools in dismantling geographical asymmetries. By granting provincial scholars instantaneous access to authentic C2 corpora and diagnostic feedback loops, digital ecosystems have dismantled long-standing monopolies on elite academic preparation. To this extent, technology functions as an indispensable force multiplier for self-directed mastery.

Beneath this veneer of empowerment, however, lies a more insidious cognitive trade-off. Engineered to maximize behavioral engagement, attention-extractive interfaces systematically fragment working memory, rendering the sustained contemplation requisite for dialectical reasoning increasingly elusive. Worse still, when learners outsource analytical synthesis to generative shortcuts, they risk mistaking fluent output for genuine conceptual comprehension—a phenomenon that inexorably hollows out intellectual resilience.

In the final analysis, it is imperative that educational institutions walk a tightrope between embracing technological utility and safeguarding cognitive sovereignty. Only by anchoring curricula in rigorous first-principles reasoning can we ensure that technology remains a subservient instrument rather than the arbiter of human thought.
